this is the very highest of all.

this is rendering the country unsafe.

puj: chiá sĩ tõ pa̍t nâng kò la-chhé lâi kâi

these are a set of lawless fellows; roughs and vagabonds.

since it is me, very well.

puj: chiá sĩ ēng tshûn ṳ̂-sīn kâi

puj: chiá sĩ ũ pêng ũ kṳ̃ kâi

en: this is something for which there is proof.
this is showing him unmerited favor.
this is a far reaching scheme.

puj: chiá sǹg sì ũ kò bô sù kâi

puj: chiá sǹg sĩ bô ki tsṳ thâm

en: these may be reckoned as unfounded assertions.

puj: chiá sǹg sĩ chhiû phun kâi

puj: chiá sǹg sĩ hiuⁿ-hiuⁿ hùam-hùam kâi uē

en: this can only be done by one who is very gentle and careful.

en: you must pick it up with tongs.
this one must be tied up and whipped.

en: must call a dwarf to prop it on.

puj: chiá tie̍h kòu bī-tsúi kâi chiàⁿ liô tit tie̍h

en: divers must be employed and then it can be brought up.

puj_orig: cía tîeh m̄ kù sin ke cìaⁿ káⁿ kàng
en: in order to protest against this one must be regardless of his personal interests.

puj: chiá tie̍h ngiâm kiù kàu thiet-tói
puj_orig: cía tîeh ngîam kìu kàu thiet-tói
en: this must be sifted to the bottom.

en: the tonics mnst follow the depleting medicines, it is not well to first give restoratives and then give purgatives.

puj: chiá tie̍h sài kang lió chiàⁿ hó ngói
puj_orig: cía tîeh sài kang lío cìaⁿ hó̤ ngói
en: this must first be dried thoroughly in the sun, and then it may be ground fine.

puj: chiá tie̍h tsang kha pa-chiéⁿ lâi phah
puj_orig: cía tîeh cang kha pa-cíeⁿ lâi phah
en: he ought to be kicked for it.

puj: chiá tie̍h tsang nńg soh lâi pa̍k
puj_orig: cía tîeh cang ńng so̤h lâi pâk
en: must tie this with a slack rope; must use gentleness in order to bind.

puj: chiá tie̍h tsò-nî lâi tshù-tì chiàⁿ ho?2

en: In what way should this be decided?

puj: chiá tie̍h tsò-nî ni-tî chiàⁿ ho?2
puj_orig: cía tîeh cò̤-nî ni-tî cìaⁿ hó̤?
en: What is the proper method of treatment in this case?
he must be largely rewarded for this.

puj: chiá tie̍h ùn ka-ki,7 màiⁿ ùn pa̍t nâng
puj_orig: cía tîeh ẁn ka-kī, màiⁿ ẁn pât nâng
en: you should blame yourself for this, not other people.

puj: chiá tie̍h ēng nńg si,3 m̄ hó ēng ngẽ sì

en: in this, gentleness not severity must be exercised.

en: What sort of glue must be used in order to make this adhere?

puj_orig: cía tîeh ēng thih-teng lâi tèng
en: this must be nailed with a nail.

puj_orig: cí khí mo̤ⁿ kìe cò̤ hŏng-búe-mo̤ⁿ
en: this species of fern is called the phenix-tail.

puj: chí khí mue̍h m̄-hó eng tieh,5 eng tie̍h tsū chheⁿ-meⁿ
puj_orig: cí khí mûeh m̄-hó̤ eng tîeh, eng tîeh cū cheⁿ-meⁿ
en: do not get this in your eyes, if you do it will blind you.

puj: chí khí m̄ sĩ liu,5 sĩ kiè-tsò iû
puj_orig: cí khí m̄ sĭ lîu, sĭ kìe-cò̤ îu
en: this is not a tumor, it is called a wen.
this silver is too far below the standard.

puj: chí khí nâng bô bũn bô kièn
puj_orig: cí khí nâng bô̤ bŭn bô̤ kìen
en: these people have learned nothing by experience.

puj: chí khí nâng kio khîm siu,3 bô ĩ
puj_orig: cí khí nâng kio khîm sìu, bô̤ ĭ
en: such people are not in any way different from wild animals.

puj: chí khí nâng put tsouk tãu
puj_orig: cí khí nâng put cok tău
en: such people are not worth talking about.

puj: chí khí pòu ió oi̍h tōu
puj_orig: cí khí pò ío ôih tō

en: this ailment is of no consequence.

puj: chí khí pēⁿ sĩ tòung-hak,1 m̄ sĩ tòung-sú
puj_orig: cí khí pēⁿ sĭ tòng-hak, m̄ sĭ tòng-sú

puj: chí khí pēⁿ õi uè nâng
puj_orig: cí khí pēⁿ ŏi ùe nâng

puj: chí khí pēⁿ ā sĩ siũ póu tsū hó ui,1 m̄ siũ póu tsū m̄-hó ui
puj_orig: cí khí pēⁿ ā sĭ sĭu pó cū hó̤ ui, m̄ sĭu pó cū m̄-hó̤ ui
en: in this disease, if the system will bear strengthening remedies, a cure may be affected, but if not, then it is incurable.

puj: chí khí sṳ̄ i tsn̂g kâi m̄ ji̍p mn̂g
puj_orig: cí khí sṳ̄ i cn̂g kâi m̄ jîp mn̂g
en: he shows no aptness at all for this sort of thing.

puj: chí khí sṳ̄ kâi chhéng-pī tsōi tsãi
puj_orig: cí khí sṳ̄ kâi chéng-pī cōi căi
en: there are many difficulties in this business.

puj: chí khí thâng sĩ chia̍h tiũ-tâ kâi
puj_orig: cí khí thâng sĭ cîah tĭu-tâ kâi
en: this sort of grub eats grain.

puj: chí khí thâng õi kit kóiⁿ kâi
puj_orig: cí khí thâng ŏi kit kóiⁿ kâi

puj: chí khí tie̍h soiⁿ chìm-phò chiàⁿ sói tit chheng-khih
puj_orig: cí khí tîeh soiⁿ cìm-phò̤ cìaⁿ sói tit cheng-khih
en: this must first be soaked up, then it will wash off.

puj: chí khí tsháu-chhie̍h kâi hue-jī ió ngiá
puj_orig: cí khí cháu-chîeh kâi hue-jī ío ngía
en: the figures in this sort of matting are prettier.

puj: chí khí tshôiⁿ ió tūa tiô
puj_orig: cí khí chôiⁿ ío tōa tîo
en: this sort of silk-worm is large.

puj: chí khí tsúa ió kau,6 hṳ́ khí khah po̍h
puj_orig: cí khí cúa ío kău, hṳ́ khí khah pô̤h
en: this sort of paper is thicker, that sort is too thin.

puj: chí khí tsûa bô mih kã nâng
puj_orig: cí khí cûa bô̤ mih kă nâng
en: this species of snake is not apt to bite.

puj: chí khí táu lâi phah hṳ́ khí táu che̍k táu chiàⁿ tsa̍p-sì tâng
puj_orig: cí khí táu lâi phah hṳ́ khí táu cêk táu cìaⁿ câp-sì tâng
en: if these pecks were measured out in pecks of that size, there would be about seven-tenths as many.

puj: chí khí tūa ũ nõ uê
puj_orig: cí khí tōa ŭ nŏ̤ ûe
en: this sort is larger by two fold; it is three times as large.

puj: chí khí uàⁿ hûiⁿ jie̍h kú tsoung-kú bô kak!1
puj_orig: cí khí ùaⁿ hûiⁿ jîeh kú cong-kú bô̤ kak!
en: How long this case hangs on without ever coming to a settlement!
How many varieties are there in this species?

puj: chí khûn ah àiⁿ jiō khṳ̀ tī-ko?3
puj_orig: cí khûn ah àiⁿ jīo khṳ̀ tī-kò̤?
en: Where are you going to drive this drove of ducks?
this branch has no long twig at the end.

puj: chí ki chek liám lió bô hièⁿ kng
puj_orig: cí ki cek líam lío bô̤ hìeⁿ kng
en: this candle does not give a good light.
How many prongs has this fork?

puj: chí ki chhin,3 nié chièⁿ tua,7 kṳn chièⁿ siám
puj_orig: cí ki chìn, níe cìeⁿ tōa, kṳu cìeⁿ síam
en: on this steelyard, the ounces are over weight and the catties under weight.

puj: chí ki chhèng hó phah kúi hiang?2
puj_orig: cí ki chèng hó̤ phah kúi híang?
en: How many balls does this revolver carry?

puj: chí ki chiéⁿ õi iám tsúi
puj_orig: cí ki cíeⁿ ŏi íam cúi
en: this oar sinks in the water.

puj: chí ki hue khui tshut lâi kúi hah?1
puj_orig: cí ki hue khui chut lâi kúi hah?
en: How many petals has this flower?
this umbrella is light and well made.

puj: chí ki keng kúi kâi lak?5
puj_orig: cí ki keng kúi kâi lâk?
en: How much strength is required to draw this bow?

puj: chí ki khṳ̍t khah sòi ki m̄ hó pa̍k
puj_orig: cí ki khṳ̂t khah sòi ki m̄ hó̤ pâk
en: this post is too small to tie to.

puj: chí ki kun sĩ tõ móung kò tit sèng tńg lâi
puj_orig: cí ki kun sĭ tŏ̤ móng kò̤ tit sèng tńg lâi
en: this division of the army has returned from a victory in a certain place.

puj: chí ki kun sĩ tī-tiâng khùa-sue?3
puj_orig: cí ki kun sĭ tī-tîang khùa-sùe?
en: Who acts as commander-in-chief of this army?

puj: chí ki kî tūa ki,1 oh liū
puj_orig: cí ki kî tōa ki, o̤h līu
en: this flag being large is difficult to hoist.

puj: chí ki kṳ̀ hó kṳ̀ tek m̄ hó kṳ̀ sam
puj_orig: cí ki kṳ̀ hó̤ kṳ̀ tek m̄ hó̤ kṳ̀ sam
en: this saw is good to saw bamboo with but not to saw pine.

puj: chí ki mue̍h chhiáⁿ uá pàng kò
puj_orig: cí ki mûeh chíaⁿ úa pàng kò̤

puj: chí ki mue̍h ũ būn kṳn la̍k
puj_orig: cí ki mûeh ŭ bw̄n kṳn lâk
en: this will bear a strain of a thousand pounds weight upon it without breaking.

puj: chí ki pit kâi hâu ió hó
puj_orig: cí ki pit kâi hâu ío hó̤
en: this pencil has a better point.

puj: chí ki piâⁿ-bóu ũ jie̍h tsōi nang?5
puj_orig: cí ki pîaⁿ-bó ŭ jîeh cōi nâng?
en: How many men are there in this detachment of troops?

puj: chí ki sam chièⁿ tn̂g chièⁿ ti̍t hó tsò kî-kuaⁿ sam
puj_orig: cí ki sam cìeⁿ tn̂g cìeⁿ tît hó̤ cò̤ kî-kuaⁿ sam
en: this log is so long and so straight that it will do for a flag-staff.

puj: chí ki sam sie-hũ peⁿ,1 peⁿ tsò nõ pôiⁿ
puj_orig: cí ki sam sie-hŭ peⁿ, peⁿ cò̤ nŏ̤ pôiⁿ
en: help to pull apart the sides of this stick of timber and pull it in two.

puj: chí ki sam àiⁿ kṳ̀ tsò kúi lou?7
puj_orig: cí ki sam àiⁿ kṳ̀ cò̤ kúi lō?
en: How many cuts will you have made in this log?

puj: chí ki só-sî kio i kâi só-thâu sie kah
puj_orig: cí ki só̤-sî kio i kâi só̤-thâu sie kah

puj: chí ki sĩ bé keng a sĩ pōu keng?1
puj_orig: cí ki sĭ bé keng a sĭ pō keng?
en: Is this such a bow as is used by the cavalry, or by the infantry?

puj: chí ki tek lṳ́ thóiⁿ kúi tsak?1
puj_orig: cí ki tek lṳ́ thóiⁿ kúi cak?
en: How many joints do you think there are in this bamboo?

puj: chí ki teng sĩ tiâm tān-iû a sĩ tiám húe-iu?5
puj_orig: cí ki teng sĭ tîam tān-îu a sĭ tíam húe-îu?
en: Do you burn pea-nut oil or kerosene in this lamp?

puj: chí ki thiõ lṳ́ soh tit khí a soh m̄ khi?2
puj_orig: cí ki thĭo lṳ́ so̤h tit khí a so̤h m̄ khí?

puj: chí ki to bõi lai,7 bô mih hó tsoi̍h
puj_orig: cí ki to̤ bŏi lāi, bô̤ mih hó̤ côih
en: this knife is not sharp, and is not very good to cut with.

puj: chí ki to būe chêng tsháng
puj_orig: cí ki to̤ būe cêng cháng
en: this knife has not yet been made smooth by being shaven.

puj: chí ki to ió ũ mêⁿ
puj_orig: cí ki to̤ ío ŭ mêⁿ
en: this knife has a sharper edge.

puj: chí ki to khah tun,1 tie̍h khṳ̀ bûa lāi chē
puj_orig: cí ki to̤ khah tun, tîeh khṳ̀ bûa lāi cē
en: this knife is too dull, you must go sharpen it.

puj: chí ki to ũ kǹg a bo?5
puj_orig: cí ki to̤ ŭ kǹg a bô̤?
en: Is this knife edged with steel?
this stick of wood is too crooked.

puj: chí ki tsúa-âng-teng,1 tūa ki,1 tsòung pun huang tshue kue,3 hûn-lió hut õi to̍h
puj_orig: cí ki cúa-âng-teng, tōa ki, còng pun huang chue kùe, hŵn-lío hut ŏi tô̤h
en: this paper torch is a large one, and although it should be blown out by the wind, it may still be set blazing by blowing it.

puj: chí ki êⁿ sĩ chiang-chiũ tũ kâi
puj_orig: cí ki êⁿ sĭ ciang-cĭu tŭ kâi
en: this roof-beam is prevented from falling by a temporary prop.

puj: chí ki êⁿ thóiⁿ tie̍h àiⁿ chi̍h àiⁿ chi̍h
puj_orig: cí ki êⁿ thóiⁿ tîeh àiⁿ cîh àiⁿ cîh
en: this beam looks as if it were about to break.

puj: chí ki-chhìn kâi tô-chí m̄ kìⁿ khṳ̀
puj_orig: cí ki-chìn kâi tô̤-cí m̄ kìⁿ khṳ̀
en: the weight of this steelyard is missing.

puj: chí kiãⁿ ie̍h õi hiã khì
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ îeh ŏi hĭa khì
en: this sort of medicine is sedative.

puj: chí kiãⁿ kóu lâi tsū phīⁿ
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ kó lâi cū phīⁿ
en: this one is set down at a low figure.

puj: chí kiãⁿ mue̍h khie̍h khṳ̀ pun i
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ mûeh khîeh khṳ̀ pun i
en: take this and give it to him.

puj: chí kiãⁿ mue̍h lâu-pàng-kò tsò chèng-kũ
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ mûeh lâu-pàng-kò̤ cò̤ cèng-kŭ
en: keep this to use as a proof of it.

puj: chí kiãⁿ mue̍h put tãng õi khṳ̀ ṳ̀-hueh,1 jṳ̂-chhiáⁿ õi seⁿ sin hueh
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ mûeh put tăng ŏi khṳ̀ ṳ̀-hueh, jṳ̂-chíaⁿ ŏi seⁿ sin hueh
en: this stuff not only dissipates extravasated blood but it also produces new blood.

puj: chí kiãⁿ mue̍h sĩ gṳ̄ sṳ̀ kâi
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ mûeh sĭ gṳ̄ sṳ̀ kâi

puj: chí kiãⁿ mue̍h sĩ pa̍t nâng kià bōi kâi
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ mûeh sĭ pât nâng kìa bōi kâi
en: this is something some one else commissioned me to sell.

puj: chí kiãⁿ mue̍h tsò-nî i hó chia̍h uá m̄-hó chiah?5
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ mûeh cò̤-nî i hó̤ cîah úa m̄-hó̤ cîah?
en: How is it that he can eat this and I cannot?

puj: chí kiãⁿ mue̍h tsū tsòung uá kâi ì
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ mûeh cū còng úa kâi ì
en: this thing just meets my wishes.

puj: chí kiãⁿ mue̍h õi chia̍h hāi nâng
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ mûeh ŏi cîah hāi nâng
en: this will injure those who eat it.

puj: chí kiãⁿ mue̍h õi hâng ui,7 m̄-hó to chia̍h
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ mûeh ŏi hâng ūi, m̄-hó̤ to̤ cîah
en: this chills the stomach, and it is not well to eat much of it.
this food has no nourishment in it.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sĩ móung nâng pàng tiō kâi chhiú búe
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sĭ móng nâng pàng tīo kâi chíu búe
en: this is a relict of a certain person.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sū chhiáⁿ tī-tiâng tshut lâi kiaⁿ?5
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sū chíaⁿ tī-tîang chut lâi kîaⁿ?
en: Whom will you invite to take the lead in this matter?

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ bô keng kùe uá kâi chhiu,2 uá m̄ tsai
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ bô̤ keng kùe úa kâi chíu, úa m̄ cai
en: this affair did not come under my management and I do not know.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ bô thâu bô su,5 tsò-nî lí
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ bô̤ thâu bô̤ sû, cò̤-nî lí
en: there is nothing to guide one to an understanding of what is to be done in this affair, and so how can it be managed?

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ būe hó tsò
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ būe hó̤ cò̤
en: this should not yet be done.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ chhiáⁿ khueh-gî pàng kò
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ chíaⁿ khueh-gî pàng kò̤
en: do not giye this full credence at once.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ chhèng ì tsãi
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ chèng ì căi

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ chì a m̄ chi?3
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ cì a m̄ cì?

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ hûiⁿ tõ sim tèng
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ hûiⁿ tŏ̤ sim tèng
en: this affair is undecided in his mind.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ i chièⁿ-seⁿ tàⁿ lṳ́ thoiⁿ jiên a m̄ jien?5
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ i cìeⁿ-seⁿ tàⁿ lṳ́ thoiⁿ jîen a m̄ jîen?
en: Do you consider what he says about this probable or improbable?

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ i kâi sèⁿ ió kṳ̃n
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ i kâi sèⁿ ío kṳ̆n
en: this is something that he would learn more easily, having a natural bent toward it.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ kau-tài lṳ́ tsò
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ kau-tài lṳ́ cò̤
en: hand this business over to you for accomplishment.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ khah hiam,2 m̄-hó tsò
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ khah híam, m̄-hó̤ cò̤
en: this is too dangerous, do not do it.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ khang-liên kàu tūa bó mue̍h nâng
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ khang-lîen kàu tōa bó̤ mûeh nâng
en: this affair compromises a great number of people.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ khuah mng,5 hṳ́ kâi oi̍h mn̂g
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ khuah mn̂g, hṳ́ kâi ôih mn̂g
en: this is an extensive business, that is one that offers no room for expansion.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ kun-hĩ hui khin
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ kwn-hĭ hui khin
en: the consequences of this affair are of no slight importance.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ kài mãuⁿ-pēⁿ sĩ tõ chí kâi nâng
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ kài măuⁿ-pēⁿ sĭ tŏ̤ cí kâi nâng
en: the trouble in this matter lies in this individual.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ kâi sí-mu̍t lṳ́ tàⁿ uá thiaⁿ
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ kâi sí-mŵt lṳ́ tàⁿ úa thiaⁿ
en: relate the whole affair to me from beginning to end.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ kùe ì tsãi
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ kùe ì căi

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ lâi môung-ûi kàu sêng
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ lâi mông-ûi kàu sêng
en: let us plan for this till it is accomplished.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ lí kàu chheng-tshó he̍k tsãi
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ lí kàu cheng-chó̤ hêk căi
en: when I had finished up this business I was very tired.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ lṳ́ thoiⁿ ōi kièn chhiè me?7
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ lṳ́ tho̤iⁿ ōi kìen chìe mē?
en: Do you not think this absurd?

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ m̄ hó lāu-huang
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ m̄ hó̤ lāu-huang
en: do not breathe a word concerning this matter.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ m̄ hó sńg
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ m̄ hó̤ sńg
en: this is not a matter that you can afford to trifle about.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ m̄ sĩ uá keng-kún kâi
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ m̄ sĭ úa keng-kẃn kâi
en: this matter is outside my jurisdiction.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ put lêng lió
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ put lêng lío
en: there is no end to this affair.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ put tsouk kuài
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ put cok kùai
en: there is nothing very wonderful about this.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ siang-în kúi peh nî tou sĩ chièⁿ-seⁿ tsò
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ siang-în kúi peh nî to sĭ cìeⁿ-seⁿ cò̤
en: this sort of business has been done in this way for several hundred years in succession.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ si̍t tsãi khó kia
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sît căi khó̤ kia

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ hũam huap,1 m̄-hó tsò
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sĭ hŭam huap, m̄-hó̤ cò̤
en: this is against the rules, and must not be done.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ i chhiàng-sí kâi
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sĭ i chìang-sí kâi
en: it was he who instigated this.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ i kio i ut-sûn
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sĭ i kio i wt-sŵn
en: this affair has been managed for her by him.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ i tó khiē-le̍k
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sĭ i tó̤ khīe-lêk
en: he is taking an unlawful advantage in this.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ i tó pá-thî
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sĭ i tó̤ pá-thî
en: he has direction of this affair.

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ kua chíⁿ kouk,1 a kua hiâⁿ miaⁿ?2
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sĭ kua cíⁿ kok, a kua hîaⁿ míaⁿ?
en: Is this business to bo referred to the clerk in the prefects office, or to the legal counsel who manages criminal cases in the local court?

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ tī-tiâng khí i?3
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sĭ tī-tîang khí ì?
en: Who was it that started this idea?

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ tī-tiâng khí-i?3
puj_orig: cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sĭ tī-tîang khí-ì?
en: Who first started the idea of doing this?

puj: chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ tī-tiâng tó tsú-tshai?5

the sleeves of this garment are too small.

en: this hill is bare, having neither trees nor shrubs on it.

puj: chí kâi suaⁿ thap ji̍p hoh chhi khṳ̀

en: this is one who has lately entered the sect.

puj_orig: cí kâi sĭ tit sim kâi nâng

puj_orig: cí kâi sĭ tŏ̤ tìn-phio kò̤, hṳ́ kâi sĭ tŏ̤ thî-phio kò̤

puj: chí kâi sĩ ui lãi-khue,1 hú kâi sĩ ui gūa-khue

this business which we have on hand.

puj_orig: cí kâi tam-sêng m̄ phû, tîeh chíaⁿ kâi tam-sêng tit phû kâi lâi tam-sêng

puj: chí kâi tie̍h ũ tūa-tūa tiô kâi nā chiàⁿ hó poi̍h

puj_orig: cí kâi tíaⁿ sĭ seⁿ cù kâi a sĭ thih cù kâi?
en: Is this caldron made of steel or of iron?

puj: chí kâi tn̂g-suaⁿ-nâng sĩ sin-tn̂g a lãu-tng?5
puj_orig: cí kâi tn̂g-suaⁿ-nâng sĭ sin-tn̂g a lău-tn̂g?
en: Is this Chinaman a recent or an old immigrant here?

puj_orig: cí kâi chú cò̤ seng, cí kâi chú cò̤ tòaⁿ, cí kâi hó̤ chú cò̤ thíu
en: that one will do for a male performer, that one can act the part of a female, and this one may be the clown.

puj: chí kâi tsoih nín cheng ũ jie̍h tsōi kue?2
puj_orig: cí kâi coih nín ceng ŭ jîeh cōi kúe?
en: How many cakes did you make for this festival?
this is not so perfect as that.

puj: chí kâi tsui khí lai,5 chí kâi thap lo̍h khṳ̀
puj_orig: cí kâi cui khí lâi, cí kâi thap lô̤h khṳ̀
en: this protrudes, and that juts in.

puj: chí kâi tsun-tshùi ēng ũ lô-si
puj_orig: cí kâi cun-chùi ēng ŭ lô̤-si
en: the top of this flask screws on.

puj: chí kâi tsàng sĩ kiâm kâi a sĩ tiâm kai?5
puj_orig: cí kâi càng sĭ kîam kâi a sĭ tîam kâi?
en: Have these dumplings a sweet or a salt filling?

puj: chí kâi tsúa-iē pàng lâi kûiⁿ tsãi
puj_orig: cí kâi cúa-īe pàng lâi kûiⁿ căi

this is the evidence of it.

puj_orig: cí kâi cṳ-ce tī-tîang có̤ tong-ke?
en: Who is the master of this school?

puj: chí kâi tsṳ-niê-kiáⁿ hṳ́-phùe khṳt i
puj_orig: cí kâi cṳ-nîe-kíaⁿ hṳ́-phùe khṳt i
en: this girl is betrothed to him.

puj: chí kâi tsṳ-niê-kiáⁿ íⁿ-keng hṳ́ kè lió
puj_orig: cí kâi cṳ-nîe-kíaⁿ íⁿ-keng hṳ́ kè lío
en: this damsel is already promised in marriage.

puj: chí kâi tuaⁿ àiⁿ hũe khṳt tī-tiang?5
puj_orig: cí kâi toaⁿ àiⁿ hŭe khṳt tī-tîang?
en: In whose favor is this order to be written?

puj: chí kâi tàⁿ khah tang,6 uá taⁿ m̄ khí
puj_orig: cí kâi tàⁿ khah tăng, úa taⁿ m̄ khí
en: this burden is too heavy, I cannot lift it.

puj: chí kâi tàⁿ tit ue,7 hṳ́ kâi tàⁿ m̄ tit uē
puj_orig: cí kâi tàⁿ tit ūe, hṳ́ kâi tàⁿ m̄ tit ūe
en: this is something worth hearing, while that is not.

puj: chí kâi táⁿ tūa tsai,6 tsn̂g kâi m̄ ùi-kiaⁿ
puj_orig: cí kâi táⁿ tōa căi, cn̂g kâi m̄ ùi-kiaⁿ
en: this one is very courageous, and is not easily perturbed.

puj: chí kâi tìn kún ũ jie̍h tsōi iaⁿ?5
puj_orig: cí kâi tìn kẃn ŭ jîeh cōi îaⁿ?
en: How many corps has this general under his command?

puj: chí kâi tî hó pàng hṳ̂
puj_orig: cí kâi tî hó̤ pàng hṳ̂
en: this pool is a good place to keep fish.

puj: chí kâi tî kâi thuah kãu tsãi
puj_orig: cí kâi tî kâi thuah kău căi
en: there are very many otters in this pool.
this one takes charge of the dispatches.

puj: chí kâi tõ-lí tsò-nî káng-kiù ne?7
puj_orig: cí kâi tŏ̤-lí cò̤-nî káng-kìu nē?

puj: chí kâi tõ-lí tsū khiông m̄ tshut
puj_orig: cí kâi tŏ̤-lí cū khîong m̄ chut
en: cannot search to the botton of this principle.

puj: chí kâi tõ-lí tsū siẽⁿ m̄ phùa
puj_orig: cí kâi tŏ̤-lí cū sĭeⁿ m̄ phùa
en: I did not think out this principle.

en: this pounder does not fit this mortar.

puj_orig: cí kâi tī cìeⁿ khuah, cêk nî ēng lâp jîeh cōi bó chân nîe?
en: On a piece of land as large as this how much must be paid annually in taxes?

puj: chí kâi tī chẽng sĩ sua
puj_orig: cí kâi tī cĕng sĭ sua
en: this soil consists wholly of sand.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng bô nâng õi e̍k uē
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng bô̤ nâng ŏi êk ūe
en: there is no one here who can act as interpreter.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng chẽng sĩ suaⁿ
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng cĕng sĭ suaⁿ

puj: chí kâi tī-hng hó kiẽn tsò siâⁿ
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng hó̤ kĭen cò̤ sîaⁿ
en: this would be a good place to build a city.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng ió chié teng-tou̍k
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng ío cíe teng-tôk
en: there is but little running to and fro in social intercourse here abouts.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng ió pêⁿ-thang,2 bõi sia-kiã
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng ío pêⁿ-tháng, bŏi sia-kĭa
en: this place is level, not inclined.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng ió thap,1 õi tsũ tsúi
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng ío thap, ŏi cŭ cúi
en: this spot is hollowed out, and water may collect in it.
this is a more quiet spot.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng khah hip huang
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng khah hip huang
en: this place is too much shut off from the wind.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng khah khàng iâng
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng khah khàng îang
en: this place is excessively bare and destitute of shade.
this place is too remote and difficult to reach.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng lâi pī sú hó tsâi
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng lâi pī sú hó̤ câi
en: this is a good place to go to escape the heat.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng put lî nâng
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng put lî nâng
en: there is always some one here.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng sĩ tsǹg kou-lôu kâi
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng sĭ cǹg ko-lô kâi
en: this is a place where old human bones are interred.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng sĩm sĩ hiuⁿ-chẽⁿ
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng sĭm sĭ hiuⁿ-cĕⁿ
en: this is a very retired spot.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng tshut siãng tsōi
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng chut sĭang cōi
en: this region produces the greatest amount.
this region is stricken with a plague.

puj: chí kâi tī-hng uá m̄ pat kàu
puj_orig: cí kâi tī-hng úa m̄ pat kàu
en: I have not before been here.

puj_orig: cí kâi tō̤ tìeⁿ kàu pit

en: this large bowl holds two quarts of rice.

puj: chí kâi uá bói ngõu-tsa̍p kâi în-chîⁿ
puj_orig: cí kâi úa bói ngŏ-câp kâi în-cîⁿ
en: I bought this for fifty silver pieces.

puj: chí kâi uē sĩ i chiàⁿ káⁿ tàⁿ
puj_orig: cí kâi ūe sĭ i cìaⁿ káⁿ tàⁿ
en: this sort of talk only he dare indulge in.

puj: chí kâi uē tàⁿ lâi bô phóu
puj_orig: cí kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi bô̤ phó
en: what was said, was wholly unreliable.

puj: chí kâi uē tàⁿ tshut lâi bô kṳn
puj_orig: cí kâi ūe tàⁿ chut lâi bô̤ kṳn
en: there is no foundation for this story.

puj: chí kâi ãⁿ sĩ khṳt nâng phah tie̍h a sĩ tsuãng tieh?5
puj_orig: cí kâi ăⁿ sĭ khṳt nâng phah tîeh a sĭ cŭang tîeh?
en: Is this swelling caused by a blow or by a bump?

puj: chí kâi õi kang õi jiû
puj_orig: cí kâi ŏi kang ŏi jîu
en: this is sometimes hard and sometimes flexible.
this is an antidote to poison.

puj: chí kâi ēng chîⁿ li khah khuang,3 chi kâi ēng chîⁿ li khah siap
puj_orig: cí kâi ēng cîⁿ li khah khùang, ci kâi ēng cîⁿ li khah siap
en: the one uses money too imprudently, while the other is too close-fisted.

puj: chí kâi ēng kúi kâi în-chîⁿ chiàⁿ bói tit tieh?5
puj_orig: cí kâi ēng kúi kâi în-cîⁿ cìaⁿ bói tit tîeh?
en: What amount of money will be required in order to purchase this?

puj: chí kâi ēng sùe hiàng a mien?2
puj_orig: cí kâi ēng sùe hìang a míen?

en: What is the price of this?

puj: chí kâi īⁿ bô hièⁿ au

puj_orig: cí kò̤ bô̤ hó̤ chú-chái li khṳ̀ pât kò̤ chú-chái
en: if this is not a place for earning money, go elsewhere and earn it.
there is no condiment here fit to go with fish.

puj: chí kò chie̍h póiⁿ kùe lâi
puj_orig: cí kò̤ cîeh pó̤iⁿ kùe lâi

puj: chí kò chie̍h sái i khiã
puj_orig: cí kò̤ cîeh sái i khĭa

puj: chí kò chié tshut chí kâi mue̍h
puj_orig: cí kò̤ cíe chut cí kâi mûeh
en: there is but little of this to be found here.

puj: chí kò houng-sou̍k siang-în sĩ chièⁿ-seⁿ
puj_orig: cí kò̤ hong-sôk siang-în sĭ cìeⁿ-seⁿ
en: the customs handed down here are thus.

puj: chí kò hó lâi kek kâi tsúi-tùi
puj_orig: cí kò̤ hó̤ lâi kek kâi cúi-tùi
en: this is a good place to set up a rice-pounder worked by water-power.

puj_orig: cí kò̤ khah khin, teh bô̤ bī-sò, tîeh chūe ío tăng lâi teh cìaⁿ ŭ bī-sò
en: this is too light and it is of no use to lay it on as a weight, something heavier must be sought and then it will be effectual.

puj: chí kò khèng kâi im hó tsai,6 tiang-tiang-kiè
puj_orig: cí kò̤ khèng kâi im hó̤ căi, tiang-tiang-kìe
en: this dulcimer gives forth a very sweet sound, as it twangs.

puj: chí kò kâi houng-sou̍k ió hó
puj_orig: cí kò̤ kâi hong-sôk ío hó̤

puj: chí kò kâi kéng-tì sĩm hó
puj_orig: cí kò̤ kâi kéng-tì sĭm hó̤

puj: chí kò kâi thôu kien-jũn tsãi

en: the soil here is very mellow.

puj: chí kò kâi tsûn sĩ kiâⁿ lâu tsúi kâi
puj_orig: cí kò̤ kâi cûn sĭ kîaⁿ lâu cúi kâi
en: the boats hereabouts are made to go with the current.

puj: chí kò kâi tî khut tsōi

puj: chí kò kâi tōu ió sòi
puj_orig: cí kò̤ kâi tō ío sòi

puj_orig: cí kò̤ kó̤ khîeh khṳ̀ thîn cheng
en: take this draft and make an exact and fair copy.

puj: chí kò lâng-kang lau̍h-hauh,5 m̄ hóuy hàm sin khùa lo̍h khṳ̀
puj_orig: cí kò̤ lâng-kang lâuh-hâuh, m̄ hóy hàm sin khùa lô̤h khṳ̀
en: this railing is old and shaky, you must not lean your whole weight upon it.

puj: chí kò lî hâng-sià m̄ hñg
puj_orig: cí kò̤ lî hâng-sìa m̄ hn̆g
en: this is not far from my poor abode.

puj: chí kò mue̍h tōiⁿ kùe thih
puj_orig: cí kò̤ mûeh tōiⁿ kùe thih

en: this piece is not enough to make it of.
this flesh is from an animal that has just been killed.

puj: chí kò ne̍k mién kùi ji̍t tsū hu-hiúⁿ khṳ̀
puj_orig: cí kò̤ nêk míen kùi jît cū hu-híuⁿ khṳ̀
en: this piece of meat will become putrid before many days.
this board has knots in it.

puj: chí kò pi sip-sip-peh,5 hṳ́ kò pi tak-tak-la̍h
puj_orig: cí kò̤ pi sip-sip-pêh, hṳ́ kò̤ pi tak-tak-lâh
en: this tablet is a solid white and that one is a mottled gray.

puj: chí kò siò lṳ́ khà thóiⁿ tùi mē
puj_orig: cí kò̤ sìo lṳ́ khà thóiⁿ tùi mē
en: you reckon over this account (on the abacus) and see if it is correct.

puj: chí kò sìn khie̍h khṳ̀ kià
puj_orig: cí kò̤ sìn khîeh khṳ̀ kìa
en: take this letter and post it.

puj: chí kò sìn khie̍h khṳ̀ kià húe-tsun,5 chí kò kià tōu-tsun,5 chí kò kià pàng sìn-ke̍k-kò
puj_orig: cí kò̤ sìn khîeh khṳ̀ kìa húe-cûn, cí kò̤ kìa tō-cûn, cí kò̤ kìa pàng sìn-kêk-kò̤
en: take this letter and put it on board the steam-boat to be carried, take this one and forward it by the ferry boat, and take this one and put it in the post-office.

puj: chí kò sĩ kùe kiap kâi tī-hng
puj_orig: cí kò̤ sĭ kùe kiap kâi tī-hng
en: this is the dividing ridge of the hills.
the centre of the current is here.

puj: chí kò sĩ tsho tshut me̍h kâi tī-hng
puj_orig: cí kò̤ sĭ cho̤ chut mêh kâi tī-hng
en: this is where the family first came from.

puj: chí kò sĩ tsóung kṳn thâu
puj_orig: cí kò̤ sĭ cóng kṳn thâu

en: this is the centre of the plat.

puj: chí kò sĩ uē tsò tī-po
puj_orig: cí kò̤ sĭ ūe cò̤ tī-po̤
en: this represents the ground in the picture.

puj: chí kò sũ sĩ tī-tiâng tsò kai?5
puj_orig: cí kò̤ sŭ sĭ tī-tîang cò̤ kâi?

puj: chí kò thòu kâi tûn chièⁿ ngiá tiāⁿ-tie̍h ũ hu̍t
puj_orig: cí kò̤ thò kâi tûn cìeⁿ ngía tīaⁿ-tîeh ŭ hŵt
en: just here where a lip protrudes there is sure to be a grave.

puj: chí kò thôu sĩ sip tsãi
puj_orig: cí kò̤ thô sĭ sip căi
en: the soil here is very wet.

puj: chí kò ti,7 hó chèng ũ kúi táu cheng?2
puj_orig: cí kò̤ tī, hó̤ cèng ŭ kúi táu céng?
en: How many pecks of seeds should be put into this lot?

puj: chí kò tiam ho,2 tsoi̍h lió bõi mih seⁿ tiam-sut
puj_orig: cí kò̤ tiam hó̤, côih lío bŏi mih seⁿ tiam-sut
en: this meat-block is a good one, and after you chop things on it, it has not chips of the wood on it.

puj: chí kò tièⁿ-bâi sĩ kièn kâi a sĩ tiû kai?5
puj_orig: cí kò̤ tìeⁿ-bâi sĭ kìen kâi a sĭ tîu kâi?
en: Is this valance for the top of the bedstead made of lutestring or of plain thin silk?

puj: chí kò tshâ tōiⁿ tsai,6 hó lâi liú tsò tshâ-khũ
puj_orig: cí kò̤ châ tōiⁿ căi, hó̤ lâi líu cò̤ châ-khŭ
en: this block of wood is very solid, it will be well to scoop it out and make a mortar of it.

puj: chí kò tshân thóiⁿ tie̍h bóu-siaⁿ ió oi̍h
puj_orig: cí kò̤ chân thóiⁿ tîeh bó-siaⁿ ío ôih
en: I should think this lot the smaller.

puj: chí kò tshâng pheⁿ-phah àiⁿ chèng tsò tiũ ho,2 a sĩ àiⁿ chèng tsò chià ho,2 a sĩ àiⁿ chèng tsò hun-kuah ho?2
puj_orig: cí kò̤ châng pheⁿ-phah àiⁿ cèng cò̤ tĭu hó̤, a sĭ àiⁿ cèng cò̤ cìa hó̤, a sĭ àiⁿ cèng cò̤ hun-kuah hó̤?
en: Have you decided that it is best to plant this ground to flax, to sugarcane, or to potatoes?

puj: chí kò tshâng sì lo̍h tāu-khou hó a sĩ lo̍h tṳ-kut ho?2
puj_orig: cí kò̤ châng sì lô̤h tāu-kho hó̤ a sĭ lô̤h tṳ-kut hó̤?
en: Which is the best fertilizer for this field, bean-cake or bone-dust?

puj: chí kò tshâng sĩ nín kâi a sĩ in kai?5
puj_orig: cí kò̤ châng sĭ nín kâi a sĭ in kâi?
en: Is this field yours or theirs?

puj: chí kò tshù-tī ũ tsa̍p bóu khuah

en: it is safe to eat mushrooms that are of spontaneous growth, if you gather them yourself, but if you carelessly buy them there is danger of their being poisonous and that you may be injured by them.

puj: hũam mue̍h chē háng tsū kièn tien
puj_orig: hŭam mûeh cē háng cū kìen tien

puj: hũam nâng tàⁿ-uē tie̍h màiⁿ hṳ-bû

everything must be done in its proper order.

in all things one must be considerate of others.

puj: hũam sṳ̄ tie̍h õi siẽⁿ kú-tn̂g

in all things there must be accommodation to circumstances.

puj: hũam sṳ̄ tou tie̍h khúi-ta̍k chhêng-lí

whatever business you have on hand, you must conduct it with care.

meet adverse influences in the cycle of twelve.

puj: hṳ́ ki po̍h-táu kiáⁿ m̄-hó tsãi

puj_orig: i kâi sèⁿ-thâu m̄-hó̤ căi, sèⁿ cē lâi mih mûeh m̄ kẃn
en: ho has a very bad temper, and whenever it is roused lie pays no heed to anything.

puj: i kâi sì khah tua,7 nâng m̄ tshap i
puj_orig: i kâi sì khah tōa, nâng m̄ chap i
en: he is too authoritative and people will not associate with him.

puj: i kâi sì sĩ chia̍h tùi hṳ́-kò khṳ̀
puj_orig: i kâi sì sĭ cîah tùi hṳ́-kò̤ khṳ̀
en: its force trends in that direction.

puj: i kâi sì-si kio nín sie tâng me?7
puj_orig: i kâi sì-si kio nín sie tâng mē?
en: Is his genealogy the same as yours?

puj: i kâi sì-thí môung tie̍h tsn̂g kâi ngân-ngân
puj_orig: i kâi sì-thí mông tîeh cn̂g kâi ngân-ngân
en: his whole body feels cold to the touch.

puj: i kâi sìn ti̍t-ti̍t ta̍k kàu lãu-tia hṳ́ lãi
puj_orig: i kâi sìn tît-tît tâk kàu lău-tia hṳ́ lăi
en: his letter was forwarded directly to the magistrate.

puj: i kâi sìⁿ kut kuah tsò poih tsùn-bé
puj_orig: i kâi sìⁿ kut kuah cò̤ poih cùu-bé
en: the ribs of his fan had the eight steeds carved thereon.

puj: i kâi sí hûn phû lió
puj_orig: i kâi sí hûn phû lío
en: he has the signs of death upon him.

puj: i kâi sî théng m̄ khui
i kâi sòi khái siá khṳ̀ ngiá
puj_orig: i kâi sòi khái sía khṳ̀ ngía
en: his small square characters are well written.

puj: i kâi sòi kâi kiáⁿ kùe kì pun i a-hiaⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi sòi kâi kíaⁿ kùe kì pun i a-hiaⁿ
en: he passed his youngest son over to his elder brother, to be his heir.

puj: i kâi sù sèⁿ sĩ chièⁿ-seⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi sù sèⁿ sĭ cìeⁿ-seⁿ

en: he is very rash and headstrong.

puj: i kâi súa-pōu súa lâi ún-tàng
puj_orig: i kâi súa-pō súa lâi ún-tàng
en: he moves about on his feet with great precision.

puj: i kâi sún chē tàu m̄ kín tsū louk-louk khùaⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi sún cē tàu m̄ kín cū lok-lok khùaⁿ
en: if the tenon is not mortised in tightly it will rattle around.

puj: i kâi sĩ hiàng-tǹg a sĩ hō-tng?3
puj_orig: i kâi sĭ hìang-tǹg a sĭ hō̤-tǹg?
en: Is his a licensed or an unlicensed pawn-shop?

puj: i kâi sĩ kiè-sĩ khah khuaⁿ-ua̍h a m̄ si?6
puj_orig: i kâi sĭ kìe-sĭ khah khuaⁿ-ûah a m̄ sĭ?
en: She finds fault because things are too comfortable does she not?

puj: i kâi sĩ kú pēⁿ a sĩ tshou peⁿ?7
puj_orig: i kâi sĭ kú pēⁿ a sĭ cho pēⁿ?
en: Is his ailment one that he has had before, or is this the first time he has had it?

puj: i kâi sĩ tòung huang a sĩ tòung hang?5
puj_orig: i kâi sĭ tòng huang a sĭ tòng hâng?
en: Has she been in a draft or been chilled?

puj: i kâi sĩ tūa phiô kheh
puj_orig: i kâi sĭ tōa phîo kheh
en: he is one who spends much in lewdness.

puj: i kâi sĩ ũ sĩm-mih lâi-thau?5
puj_orig: i kâi sĭ ŭ sĭm-mih lâi-thâu?

en: What is at the bottom of it all?

puj: i kâi sǹg-pûaⁿ sǹg kàu chĩn kèⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi sǹg-pûaⁿ sǹg kàu cĭn kèⁿ
en: he has calculated it out with the utmost exactness.
his expressions are apt and elegant.
his affairs are too numerous and troublesome.

puj: i kâi sṳ̄ lió tien-tien tau-táu
puj_orig: i kâi sṳ̄ lío tien-tien tau-táu
en: what he does is left topsy-turvy.
his affair has come to an unsuccessful issue.

puj: i kâi sṳ̄ siãng to tun
puj_orig: i kâi sṳ̄ sĭang to̤ twn
en: his business is of numerous sorts.

puj: i kâi sṳ̄ sĩ tõ tì-kòu phùa-teng?6
puj_orig: i kâi sṳ̄ sĭ tŏ̤ tì-kò phùa-tĕng?
en: How did the matter come to be divulged?

puj: i kâi sṳ̄ tsò lâi thó-thiaptsãi
puj_orig: i kâi sṳ̄ cò̤ lâi thó̤-thiapcăi
en: his affairs are very thoroughly settled.

puj: i kâi ta̍k-khì chē hut tsū oh ui
puj_orig: i kâi tâk-khì cē hwt cū o̤h ui
en: if once the poison takes effect it is difficult to counteract it.

puj: i kâi teng ēng ũ lô-si a bo?5
puj_orig: i kâi teng ēng ŭ lô̤-si a bô̤?
en: Has the lamp a screw at its top?

puj: i kâi thi tie̍h nẽ thi-thi chiàⁿ thi tit tie̍h
puj_orig: i kâi thi tîeh nĕ thi-thi cìaⁿ thi tit tîeh
en: the bird-lime must be very adhesive then it will catch them.

puj: i kâi thiap tsò-nî tshut tsòu ki-hou̍k hu,1 bô tshut tsò chiãng-ki hu?1
puj_orig: i kâi thiap cò̤-nî chut cò ki-hôk hu, bô̤ chut cò̤ cĭang-ki hu?
en: How is it that the notice she has issued of her husband's funeral says "mourning" instead of "deep mourning"?

puj: i kâi thien-tsṳ tsū sĩ siãng hó kâi
puj_orig: i kâi thien-cṳ cū sĭ sĭang hó̤ kâi
en: his natural gifts are of the highest order.

puj: i kâi tho tũi tiō khṳ̀
puj_orig: i kâi tho̤ tŭi tīo khṳ̀

puj: i kâi thâm phùi tshut lâi tùa hueh tiám
puj_orig: i kâi thâm phùi chut lâi tòa hueh tíam
en: there are specks of blood in the phlegm which he raises.

puj: i kâi thâm sek sĩ tùa chheⁿ a sĩ tùa ou?1
puj_orig: i kâi thâm sek sĭ tòa cheⁿ a sĭ tòa o?
en: Is the phlegm which he raises flecked with green or with black?

puj: i kâi thâm õi chheⁿ,1 sĩ liâng thâm a m̄ sĩ
puj_orig: i kâi thâm ŏi cheⁿ, sĭ lîang thâm a m̄ sĭ
en: the mucous from his throat is greenish, it is the effect of a cold is it not?

puj: i kâi thâu hîn kàu tãng tsai,6 tsn̂g kâi tièⁿ m̄ phû
puj_orig: i kâi thâu hîn kàu tăng căi, cn̂g kâi tìeⁿ m̄ phû
en: her head is very dizzy, so that she cannot raise it at all.

puj: i kâi thâu kha̍p kàu kâi ãⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi thâu khâp kàu kâi ăⁿ
en: he bumped his head so hard as to make a bruise.

puj: i kâi thâu lṳ̂-lṳ̂ li-li kiàⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi thâu lṳ̂-lṳ̂ li-li kìaⁿ
en: he pushed straight on with his head projecting in front of him.

puj: i kâi thâu nià-nià tó táng i lâi
puj_orig: i kâi thâu nìa-nìa tó̤ táng i lâi
en: he stood with his head turned in that direction, waiting for him.

puj: i kâi thâu siu kàu kng-kng
en: her hair is combed very smoothly.

puj: i kâi thâu ā sĩ m̄ tang,6 tī-tiâng kaⁿ?2
puj_orig: i kâi thâu ā sĭ m̄ tăng, tī-tîang káⁿ?
en: Who dares do anything except at his nod?

puj: i kâi thâu-khak seⁿ lâi tshúa
puj_orig: i kâi thâu-khak seⁿ lâi chúa

en: lie has sores on his head, arising from neglect.
his pate is bald and shiny.

puj: i kâi thâu-môⁿ nih-chhih-to,2 tsò hó tá tsang?1
puj_orig: i kâi thâu-mô̤ⁿ nih-chih-tó̤, cò̤ hó̤ tá cang?
en: Her hair is very short, how can she do it up in the style of a grown woman?
her hair is all flying at loose ends.

puj: i kâi thâu-tshah khṳt nâng thau poi̍h khṳ̀
puj_orig: i kâi thâu-chah khṳt nâng thau pôih khṳ̀
en: her head-ornament was slyly removed by some one.

puj: i kâi thóiⁿ suaⁿ pit àiⁿ káng-kiù lûn-thâu
puj_orig: i kâi thóiⁿ suaⁿ pit àiⁿ káng-kìu lŵn-thâu
en: the geomancer will surely expatiate upon the surrounding peaks.

puj: i kâi thóu-chheⁿ seⁿ lâi ngiá tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi thó-cheⁿ seⁿ lâi ngía căi
en: the end of his nose is very exquisitely formed.

puj: i kâi thôung-jîn pe̍h-bū tsn̂g kâi thóiⁿ-m̄-kìⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi thông-jîn pêh-bū cn̂g kâi thóiⁿ-m̄-kìⁿ
en: his pupil is an opaque white, and he cannot see at all.

puj: i kâi thôung-jîn êng kâi bū
puj_orig: i kâi thông-jîn en̂g kâi bū
en: the pupils of his eyes have a cloudy look all over them.

puj: i kâi thûi hue mõung-lâi hó thóiⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi thûi hue mŏng-lâi hó̤ thóiⁿ
en: he brandishes his club very gracefully.

puj: i kâi thûi khṳ̀ ke̍h khui i kâi to
puj_orig: i kâi thûi khṳ̀ kêh khui i kâi to̤
en: he warded off the knife with his club.
her clubs are of a promiscuous sort; she uses anything she can get hold of to whip with.

puj: i kâi thĩ seⁿ ku,2 íⁿ-keng sêng tsò thĩ-lāu
puj_orig: i kâi thĭ seⁿ kú, íⁿ-keng sen̂g cò̤ thĭ-lāu
en: he has had piles a long time, and they have already ulcerated.

puj: i kâi tièⁿ pàng khṳ̀ tsōi tsãi tsa̍p koiⁿ hâng phou,3 poih koiⁿ tõ i kò khie̍h ũ tièⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi tìeⁿ pàng khṳ̀ cōi căi câp koiⁿ hâng phò, poih koiⁿ tŏ̤ i kò̤ khîeh ŭ tìeⁿ
en: he has many claims for money lent on security: out of ten merchantile houses, eight have borrowed money from him, giving him a lien on their goods.

puj: i kâi tn̂g thiaⁿ,3 tóu jie̍t
puj_orig: i kâi tn̂g thìaⁿ, tó jîet
en: he has pain and inflammation in his bowels.

puj: i kâi to huap hó tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi to̤ huap hó̤ căi

en: his knife is very sharp; he is very eager for gain.

puj: i kâi to lōu se̍k tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi to̤ lō sêk căi
en: he handles his knife with dexterity, cutting downward rapidly and incessantly.

puj: i kâi to tsū khám khṳ,3 khám sieⁿ tie̍h i kâi chhiú
puj_orig: i kâi to̤ cū khám khṳ̀, khám sieⁿ tîeh i kâi chíu
en: in bringing down his knife it slipped and wounded his hand.

puj: i kâi tsam li-li niap,5 li-li nia̍p
puj_orig: i kâi cam li-li nîap, li-li nîap
en: her needle flies in and out.

puj: i kâi tsam piu̍h lo̍h khṳ̀ hiá hueh chheⁿ-sũn tshut lâi
puj_orig: i kâi cam pîuh lô̤h khṳ̀ hía hueh cheⁿ-sw̆n chut lâi
en: he thrust in his lancet and the blood gushed out.

puj: i kâi tshài-póu ta̍h kàu píⁿ-píⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi chài-pó tâh kàu píⁿ-píⁿ
en: his dried turnips are trampled down flat.

puj: i kâi tsháu-thâu chiũ ho,2 i kâi jī-nâng m̄-hó
puj_orig: i kâi cháu-thâu cĭu hó̤, i kâi jī-nâng m̄-hó̤
en: his chief wife is an amiable person, but his inferior wife is not.

puj: i kâi tshâ kai,5 m̄ hó ǹg i
puj_orig: i kâi châ kâi, m̄ hó̤ ǹg i
en: he is a dolt and no dependence can be placed on him.

puj: i kâi tshâi-chhêng bú-gōi thiò khûn
puj_orig: i kâi châi-chêng bú-gōi thìo khûn
en: his talent and military skill excel those of all the others.
he is very active in both body and mind.

puj: i kâi tshâi-chhêng put tsouk lâi tng tūa cheh-jĩm
puj_orig: i kâi châi-chêng put cok lâi tng tōa ceh-jĭm
en: his ability is not sufficient for a post of great responsibility.

puj: i kâi tshâi-chhêng si̍t-tsāi thiò khûn
puj_orig: i kâi châi-chêng sît-cāi thìo khûn
en: his abilities are above the common run.

puj: i kâi tshâng kui i kâi hiaⁿ-tĩ
puj_orig: i kâi châng kui i kâi hiaⁿ-tĭ
en: his land reverts to his brothers.
he owns an immeasurable stretch of land.

puj: i kâi tshòu-lí chē khui tsū kōi kám tie̍h huang siâ
puj_orig: i kâi chò-lí cē khui cū kōi kám tîeh huang sîa
en: when the pores are open one is more easily affected by harmful winds.

puj: i kâi tshù hñg a lṳ́ kâi tshù hng?6
puj_orig: i kâi chù hn̆g a lṳ́ kâi chù hn̆g?
en: Which is farthest off, his house or yours?

puj: i kâi tshù iū chhim iū khuah
puj_orig: i kâi chù īu chim īu khuah
en: his house is both wide and long.

puj: i kâi tshù khí lâi bõi tōiⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi chù khí lâi bŏi tōiⁿ
en: his house is not strongly built.

puj: i kâi tshù khṳt tūa phàu bū tó khṳ̀
puj_orig: i kâi chù khṳt tōa phàu bū tó̤ khṳ̀
en: his house was blown down by the cannon.

puj: i kâi tshù lauh-lauh,1 màiⁿ ta̍h tha̍p
puj_orig: i kâi chù lauh-lauh, màiⁿ tâh thâp
en: his house is very much decayed, do not cause it to cave in by stepping on it.
his house leans as if about to tumble over.

puj: i kâi tshù sĩ mīn lâm
puj_orig: i kâi chù sĭ mīn lâm

puj: i kâi tshù sĩ sùe kâi
puj_orig: i kâi chù sĭ sùe kâi
en: his house is a rented one.

puj: i kâi tshù tsn̂g kâi tó-tó tha̍p-tha̍p
puj_orig: i kâi chù cn̂g kâi tó̤-tó̤ thâp-thâp
en: his house is in a very dilapidated condition, with tumbling walls and sunken roof.

puj: i kâi tshù tsò sì-bé-thua-chhia khí
puj_orig: i kâi chù cò̤ sì-bé-thua-chia khí
en: his house is built with two pairs of rooms in front of the main hall.

puj: i kâi tshù tó kàn lī-lī
puj_orig: i kâi chù tó̤ kàn lī-lī
en: his house has tumbled down flat.

puj: i kâi tshù uang-uang kûiⁿ tūa
puj_orig: i kâi chù uang-uang kûiⁿ tōa
en: their house is roomy, high and large.

puj: i kâi tshù ũ gūa-tiâⁿ a bo?5
puj_orig: i kâi chù ŭ gūa-tîaⁿ a bô̤?
en: Is there an open court in their house?

puj: i kâi tshùi chē tàⁿ chiũ tàⁿ m̄ hàuⁿ hiah
puj_orig: i kâi chùi cē tàⁿ cĭu tàⁿ m̄ hàuⁿ hiah
en: when he once begins to talk he talks as if he were never going to stop.

puj: i kâi tshùi hàuⁿ tàⁿ uē tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi chùi hàuⁿ tàⁿ ūe căi

en: he has a very big mouth.

puj: i kâi tshùi li m̄ hauⁿ,3 i kâi sim hàuⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi chùi li m̄ hàuⁿ, i kâi sim hàuⁿ
en: he talks as if he were unwilling, but in his heart he is not averse to it.

puj: i kâi tshùi siãng tūa pe̍h-chiaⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi chùi sĭang tōa pêh-ciaⁿ

puj: i kâi tshùi tie̍h thīⁿ miⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi chùi tîeh thīⁿ miⁿ
en: sew up the mouth of it.
his mouth is drawn to one side.

puj: i kâi tshùi tu-tu,1 tó pun húe
puj_orig: i kâi chùi tu-tu, tó̤ pun húe
en: he has his mouth puckered to blow out the light.

puj: i kâi tshùi tun tsai,6 bô mih õi tàⁿ uē
puj_orig: i kâi chùi tun căi, bô̤ mih ŏi tàⁿ ūe
en: he is very slow of speech, and not fluent in talking.

puj: i kâi tshùi tàⁿ uē bô kù si̍t
puj_orig: i kâi chùi tàⁿ ūe bô̤ kù sît
en: he does not speak one word of truth.

puj: i kâi tsàu-sò tsò lâi hó tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi càu-sò̤ cò̤ lâi hó̤ căi

puj: i kâi tsáu-kiáⁿ àiⁿ lāu pàng kò chie kiáⁿ-sài kâi
puj_orig: i kâi cáu-kíaⁿ àiⁿ lāu pàng kò̤ cie kíaⁿ-sài kâi
en: they are going to keep their daughter with them and bring a husband for her into their family.

puj: i kâi tsò sṳ̄ bô tshṳ̂ bô hiông
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤ sṳ̄ bô̤ chṳ̂ bô̤ hîong
en: he does not modulate his strength.

puj: i kâi tsò sṳ̄ gia̍p-la̍k tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤ sṳ̄ gîap-lâk căi

puj: i kâi tsò sṳ̄ huàng-huàng tãng-tãng
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤ sṳ̄ hùang-hùang tăng-tăng
en: his behaviour is most reckless, unmannerly and lawless.

puj: i kâi tsò sṳ̄ khah khin-phio
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤ sṳ̄ khah khin-phio
en: his conduct is marked by too great levity.

puj: i kâi tsò sṳ̄ kúi-tsúi tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤ sṳ̄ kúi-cúi căi

puj: i kâi tsò sṳ̄ m̄ kṳ̃n nâng-chhêng
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤ sṳ̄ m̄ kṳ̆n nâng-chêng
en: he does not do things in a kindly way.

puj: i kâi tsò sṳ̄ sĩ bô pẽ-bô kun hùe kâi tsò sṳ̄
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤ sṳ̄ sĭ bô̤ pĕ-bô̤ kun hùe kâi cò̤ sṳ̄
en: his conduct is that of one who has no ruler.

puj: i kâi tsò sṳ̄ ũ pá-thî
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤ sṳ̄ ŭ pá-thî
en: he acts in a masterful way.
what is he crying so uproariously about?

puj: i kâi tsò-sṳ thèng-kang,3 màiⁿ khṳ̀ tshap i
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤-sṳ thèng-kàng, màiⁿ khṳ̀ chap i
en: his ways are lawless, do not associate with him.

puj: i kâi tsò-sṳ̄ khah khin-phio phû-tshàu
puj_orig: i kâi cò̤-sṳ̄ khah khin-phio phû-chàu
en: his conduct is too frivolous and volatile.

puj: i kâi tsóu-koung sái tõ kham tèng
puj_orig: i kâi có-kong sái tŏ̤ kham tèng
en: his ancestral tablets are set up in the shrine.

puj: i kâi tsóu-pẽ ũ koung,1 sì-si̍p ũ kuaⁿ chiak
puj_orig: i kâi có-pĕ ŭ kong, sì-sîp ŭ kuaⁿ ciak
en: his grandfather having done meritorious deeds, had hereditary office and rank bestowed on him.

puj: i kâi tsúi kek chiẽⁿ lâu-téng ēng
puj_orig: i kâi cúi kek cĭeⁿ lâu-téng ēng
en: the water is made to ascend to the second storey for use there.

puj: i kâi tsúi sĩ lo̍h ie̍h kai,5 hiá ma̍k khṳt i chē kiuh tie̍h chiũ chheⁿ-mê
puj_orig: i kâi cúi sĭ lô̤h îeh kâi, hía mâk khṳt i cē kiuh tîeh cĭu cheⁿ-mê
en: the water is medicated, and if it spurts in one's eyes one becomes blind.

puj: i kâi tsúi-sì sĩ lâi tùe khoi chièⁿ pôiⁿ kò lâi
puj_orig: i kâi cúi-sì sĭ lâi tùe khoi cìeⁿ pôiⁿ kò̤ lâi
en: the strongest current flows along down this side the river.

puj: i kâi tsûa búe kauh tõ chhiū ki ko,3 i kâi thâu tshun khṳ̀ chia̍h chió

en: he holds on to the limb with his tail, and darts his head forth to catch birds.

puj: i kâi tsûa-tsam lāng a lāng

en: he is darting out his tongue.

puj: i kâi tsûn tiam lāu khṳ̀
puj_orig: i kâi cûn tiam lāu khṳ̀
en: his boat was made to leak by hitting upon a stone.

puj: i kâi tsûn tshah ũ kî
puj_orig: i kâi cûn chah ŭ kî

puj: i kâi tsûn tó khí tèng
puj_orig: i kâi cûn tó̤ khí tèng

puj: i kâi tsûn tói sĩ tèng tâng kâi
puj_orig: i kâi cûn tói sĭ tèng tâng kâi
en: the bottom of the vessel is coppered.

puj: i kâi tsûn-thâu-bā tsuãng tiō khṳ̀
puj_orig: i kâi cûn-thâu-bā cŭang tīo khṳ̀

en: the sum of his iniquities is full.

puj: i kâi tsṳ liām khṳ̀ ku̍t-tia̍h ku̍t-tia̍h
puj_orig: i kâi cṳ līam khṳ̀ kût-tîah kût-tîah
en: he recites his lesson very glibly, without any hesitation.

puj: i kâi tsṳ se̍k kàu õi tin-tò-thâu liām
puj_orig: i kâi cṳ sêk kàu ŏi tin-tò̤-thâu līam
en: his lesson is so well learned that he can recite it backwards.

puj: i kâi tsṳ,1 chē iáⁿ ma̍k tsū pat
puj_orig: i kâi cṳ, cē íaⁿ mâk cū pat
en: he knows his lesson after just a slight glance at it.

puj: i kâi tsṳ,1 tn̂g-tn̂g àiⁿ m̄ pat
puj_orig: i kâi cṳ, tn̂g-tn̂g àiⁿ m̄ pat
en: he scarcely ever knows his lesson.

puj: i kâi tsṳ-che kiè tsò sĩm-mih hṳn?1
puj_orig: i kâi cṳ-ce kìe cò̤ sĭm-mih hṳn?
en: What appellation does he give to his school?

en_orig: In this school is the teacher's food furnish wholly by the pupils, or only in part?

puj: i kâi tsṳ-khí tsò lâi hó tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi cṳ-khí cò̤ lâi hó̤ căi
en: his report is well made out.

puj: i kâi tsṳ-lí chhim,1 nâng-chhêng mue̍h-li,2 hió khṳ̀ thàng
puj_orig: i kâi cṳ-lí chim, nâng-chêng mûeh-lí, hío khṳ̀ thàng
en: he has a profound understanding of the principles of literature, and thoroughly comprehends both human nature and physics.
his knowledge of letters is very thorough.
she has but a small family.

puj: i kâi tsṳ̃-chĩn sí sĩ chĩn tsak sí kâi
puj_orig: i kâi cṳ̆-cĭn sí sĭ cĭn cak sí kâi

puj: i kâi tàⁿ uē kio tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi tàⁿ ūe kio căi
en: he talks in a very conceited way.

puj: i kâi tàⁿ uē nẽ si̍t-sit,5 bô tsuang bô sek
puj_orig: i kâi tàⁿ ūe nĕ sît-sît, bô̤ cuang bô̤ sek
en: what he says is perfectly true, nothing is glossed or slurred over.

puj: i kâi tàⁿ uē sòi-sòi jī-ji,7 tshûn bô thèng tàⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi tàⁿ ūe sòi-sòi jī-jī, chŵn bô̤ thèng tàⁿ
en: his mode of speech is very precise, and he says nothing carelessly.

puj: i kâi tàⁿ uē tou sĩ tó phah uē tu,6 tũ kàu nâng bõi khui tshùi
puj_orig: i kâi tàⁿ ūe to sĭ tó̤ phah ūe tŭ, tŭ kàu nâng bŏi khui chùi
en: his talk is designed to stop other people's mouths, so that they will say nothing.

puj_orig: i kâi tàⁿ-ūe îu-îu cúi-cúi, bô̤ tieh-sît
en: his talk is all palaver, with no honest purpose in it.

puj_orig: i kâi tăng-kíaⁿ àiⁿ khṳ̀ phîn i kâi o kng
en: the little earthen pot is going to dash itself against the stone jar.

puj: i kâi tãng-kiáⁿ àiⁿ khṳ̀ phîn i kâi ou-kng
puj_orig: i kâi tăng-kíaⁿ àiⁿ khṳ̀ phîn i kâi o-kng
en: the little thin pickle pot is going to cast itself against the big black water-jar.

puj: i kâi tê sĩ ũ ín kâi
puj_orig: i kâi tê sĭ ŭ ín kâi
en: his tea is a neccessity with him.

puj: i kâi tîn tũa kàu hñg-hñg khṳ̀
puj_orig: i kâi tîn tŏa kàu hn̆g-hn̆g khṳ̀
en: the creeper has crept a great way.

puj: i kâi tîn tũa lâi tũa khṳ,3 tũa múaⁿ-tī-kò
puj_orig: i kâi tîn tŏa lâi tŏa khṳ̀, tŏa múaⁿ-tī-kò̤
en: the creeper has run hither and thither over everything.

puj: i kâi tó ái mih sṳ?7
puj_orig: i kâi tó̤ ái mih sṳ̄?

puj: i kâi tóu khṳt i piu̍h phùa
puj_orig: i kâi tó khṳt i pîuh phùa
en: his bowels were pierced by it

puj: i kâi tóu lâi thoung-thiet tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi tó lâi thong-thiet căi

en: he is indifferent in regard to it.

puj: i kâi tóu lãi nẽ thoung-thoung
puj_orig: i kâi tó lăi nĕ thong-thong

puj: i kâi tóu lãi tâng-tâng kng tsai
puj_orig: i kâi tó lăi tâng-tâng kng cai
en: he is very clear about it in his own mind.

puj: i kâi tóu-tsâi thóu tshut lâi
puj_orig: i kâi tó-câi thó chut lâi
en: he has rupture at the navel.

puj: i kâi tôu kuài lâi m̄ mêng-pe̍h
puj_orig: i kâi tô kùai lâi m̄ mêng-pêh
en: their chart is not drawn in such a way as to make the location of objects plain.
it is half way to the center.
his scrolls are hung wrong end upward.
What is the gist of his divination?

puj: i kâi tûn aû kháu chi̍h tàⁿ khṳ̀ hun-mêng
puj_orig: i kâi tûn âu kháu cîh tàⁿ khṳ̀ hun-mêng

puj: i kâi tûn khah tio;3 i kâi tshùi-tûn khiò-khiò
puj_orig: i kâi tûn khah tìo; i kâi chùi-tûn khìo-khìo
en: her lips curve outward very much.

puj: i kâi tĩ-tsṳ́ tou sĩ tsun i kâi kà-hùe
puj_orig: i kâi tĭ-cṳ́ to sĭ cun i kâi kà-hùe

puj: i kâi tūa nâng m̄ hàuⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi tōa nâng m̄ hàuⁿ
en: her elders in the household will not consent to it.
their rank and file are uniformly disposed.

puj: i kâi tṳ kìm tõ tṳ-lô tói
puj_orig: i kâi tṳ kìm tŏ̤ tṳ-lô̤ tói
en: her pigs are shut up in a pen.

puj: i kâi uá tī-tiâng kâi si?3
puj_orig: i kâi uá tī-tîang kâi sì?
en: Whose influence does he rely on?

puj: i kâi uē bô kù si̍t
puj_orig: i kâi ūe bô̤ kù sît
en: what he says has not a word of truth in it.

puj: i kâi uē bô tiaⁿ,7 hut sĩ hut hui
puj_orig: i kâi ūe bô̤ tīaⁿ, hut sĭ hut hui
en: what he says is unreliable, first he says one thing then another.

puj: i kâi uē chē lo̍h to,2 tsū lia̍h lo̍h khṳ̀ tiak nõ peh ē
puj_orig: i kâi ūe cē lô̤h tó̤, cū lîah lô̤h khṳ̀ tiak nŏ̤ peh ē
en: if he fails to tell the thing correctly, they seize him and beat him two hundred blows.

puj: i kâi uē chē tàⁿ tsū tàⁿ m̄ lió
puj_orig: i kâi ūe cē tàⁿ cū tàⁿ m̄ lío
en: if she once begins to talk she never stops.

puj: i kâi uē hùam-hùam lãm-lãm thèng tàⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi ūe hùam-hùam lăm-lăm thèng tàⁿ
en: his words pour forth in a stream of reckless speech.

puj: i kâi uē kù-kù hṳ,1 bô si̍t
puj_orig: i kâi ūe kù-kù hṳ, bô̤ sît
en: his words are wholly unfounded, there is no truth in them.

puj: i kâi uē lo-so tsai,6 tàⁿ bõi tit hiah
puj_orig: i kâi ūe lo̤-so̤ căi, tàⁿ bŏi tit hiah
en: she keeps prattling on as if she would never stop.
his language is intended to intimidate.

puj: i kâi uē sìn-kháu tàⁿ tshut lâi tsū sêng bûn-lí

en: on hearing what he says keep it in mind, but do not mention it.

puj: i kâi uē tou m̄ jiên li
puj_orig: i kâi ūe to m̄ jîen li
en: what he says is very improbable.

puj: i kâi uē tou sĩ kuang-kuang phièn
puj_orig: i kâi ūe to sĭ kuang-kuang phìen
en: his talk is all very misleading.

puj: i kâi uē tshûn mín phah ko,2 li-li tàⁿ

en: he has no need of writing out beforehand what he is going to say, but speaks off-hand with fluency.

puj: i kâi uē tsōi tsai,6 chiu ji̍t khṳt i tsak sí khṳ̀

en: he is a great talker, and keeps up his clack all day long.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ khṳ̀ kai-kut
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ khṳ̀ kai-kwt
en: what he said involves several meanings.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ khṳ̀ tsū tùi

en: his language varies much in force.

puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lío lap sin, ka-kī lap ka-kī
en: he implicated himself by his own talk.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lió thua nî tùa tsúi

en: he drags the subject of his speech through mud and water; he has a very turgid and verbose style of walking.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi aú-au,2 sĩ tũa chi̍h a m̄ si?6
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi áu-áu, sĭ tŏa cîh a m̄ sĭ?
en: He speaks incoherently, he is tongue-tied is he not?

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi bô ka bô liâm
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi bô̤ ka bô̤ lîam
en: what he says has no coherence.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi bô mih hiáng-liãng
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi bô̤ mih híang-lĭang
en: his voice has very little volume.

puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi bô̤ phó bô̤ pho̤h
en: what ho says is not substantiated by any evidence.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi bõi lo̍h khàng
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi bŏi lô̤h khàng
en: he talked on without any pause.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi chiⁿ-chiⁿ û-û
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi ciⁿ-ciⁿ û-û
en: what he said was wholly equivocal.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi kōi thiaⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi kōi thiaⁿ
en: it is easy to understand what he says.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi lió-lió leh-leh
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi lío-lío leh-leh
en: he speaks in a very shrill voice.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi seⁿ thóu-tham,5 bô hièⁿ chiàⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi seⁿ thó-thâm, bô̤ hìeⁿ cìaⁿ
en: he speaks with a local accent, and not very correctly.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi ũ hun ũ tshùn
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi ŭ hun ŭ chùn
en: what he says is lucidly stated.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ lâi ũ kṳn-ti,2 m̄ pí thèng tàⁿ bô kṳn bô tí
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi ŭ kṳn-tí, m̄ pí thèng tàⁿ bô̤ kṳn bô̤ tí
en: what ho says is well founded, and it is not as if he talked at random and without reason for what he says.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ m̄ khui kau
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ m̄ khui kau

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ tshut lai,5 thiaⁿ tie̍h khi-khi khio-khio
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ chut lâi, thiaⁿ tîeh khi-khi khio-khio

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ tshut lâi lêng-uāⁿ úi-ún
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ chut lâi lêng-ūaⁿ úi-ẃn

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ tshut lâi pêⁿ-sie̍h tsãi
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ chut lâi pêⁿ-sîeh căi
en: he speaks the vernacular just as other people do.

puj: i kâi uē tàⁿ tshut lâi ũ aú tói siaⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi ūe tàⁿ chut lâi ŭ áu tói siaⁿ
en: he speaks with a resonant voice.

puj: i kâi uē ũ kang ũ jiû
puj_orig: i kài ūe ŭ kang ŭ jîu
en: what he says is both firm and gentle.

puj: i kâi ãm hiám-hiám khṳt nâng phoh tñg
puj_orig: i kâi ăm híam-híam khṳt nâng pho̤h tn̆g
en: he came very near getting his neck cut in two.
his neck is long and crooked.

puj: i kâi ãm kùa che̍k pak sù-tsu
puj_orig: i kâi ăm kùa cêk pak sù-cu
en: he wears a rosary around his neck.
his neck is short and thick.

en: he was gazing with outstretched neck.

puj_orig: i kâi ăm tèng seⁿ kâi lîu
en: she has a tumor on her neck.

puj: i kâi ì tsn̂g kâi kùn-kù tõ chí-kò
puj_orig: i kâi ì cn̂g kâi kẁn-kù tŏ̤ cí-kò̤
en: his heart is wholly set upon this.

puj: i kâi ì-sṳ̀ sĩ àiⁿ hẽ chhiú lo̍h khṳ̀ sie-hũ
puj_orig: i kâi ì-sṳ̀ sĭ àiⁿ hĕ chíu lô̤h khṳ̀ sie-hŭ
en: his intention was to lay his hand on and help.

puj: i kâi ìn sĩ chiàⁿ ìn a sĩ khiâm-ki?3
puj_orig: i kâi ìn sĭ cìaⁿ ìn a sĭ khîam-kì?
en: Is his seal an official seal conferred by the government, or is it a stamp such as is given to subordinate officers?

puj: i kâi ín chē lâi pìn sin kang-khóu
puj_orig: i kâi ín cē lâi pìn sin kang-khó
en: when his craving comes on, his whole body is in distress.

puj: i kâi ín ió tang,6 lṳ́ kâi ió khin
puj_orig: i kâi ín ío tăng, lṳ́ kâi ío khin
en: his opium habit is more confirmed than is yours.

puj: i kâi ín ió tua,7 i kâi ín ió sòi
puj_orig: i kâi ín ío tōa, i kâi ín ío sòi
en: his craving is greater, his is less.

puj: i kâi ôi tsò lâi lah-hah,1 m̄ chiám-tsoi̍h
puj_orig: i kâi ôi cò̤ lâi lah-hah, m̄ cíam-côih
en: his shoes are clumsily made, and are not nicely shaped.

puj: i kâi õi nge,6 bõi nńg
puj_orig: i kâi ŏi ngĕ, bŏi ńng
en: he can be firm, but not complaisant.

puj: i kâi ûn-iú lṳ́ tàⁿ uá thiaⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi ŵn-íu lṳ́ tàⁿ úa thiaⁿ
en: relate to me the causes which lead to it.
his outlays are very carefully made.

puj: i kâi ńg-khou kún lio,2 kún ke che̍k khou pĩⁿ
puj_orig: i kâi ńg-kho kún lío, kún ke cêk kho pĭⁿ
en: having trimmed the bottom of her sleeve she laid on still another circle of braid.

puj: i kâi ūn hãng hó me?7
puj_orig: i kâi ūn hăng hó̤ mē?
en: Do the conjunctions in his horoscope indicate luck?

puj: i kã kín-kin,2 pak m̄ lut
puj_orig: i kă kín-kín, pak m̄ lut
en: he holds it very tightly between his teeth, and I cannot get it out.

en: She has married such a good husband!

puj: i kèng bô che̍k kù uē
puj_orig: i kèng bô̤ cêk kù ūe

en: after all he did not comprehend it.
he put on the costume and manners of a beggar.

puj: i kìⁿ chiēⁿ-si sĩ ka-kī chheng-tsò pui-cheh
puj_orig: i kìⁿ cīeⁿ-si sĭ ka-kī cheng-cò̤ pui-ceh
en: in meeting his superior officer he speaks of himself as an “inferior officer”.

puj: i kìⁿ tieh,5 kũi kàu tah-tah
puj_orig: i kìⁿ tîeh, kŭi kàu tah-tah
en: on seeing him, she knelt quite down.

puj: i kìⁿ tie̍h chhim chhêng kãu mãuⁿ

en: when he saw him he received him with great cordiality and deference.

puj: i kìⁿ tie̍h i tie̍h thak hia
puj_orig: i kìⁿ tîeh i tîeh thak hia
en: whenever she sees him she must bend the knee.

puj: i kìⁿ tie̍h tsṳ-niê hùe thâu tsū khap-lo̍h
puj_orig: i kìⁿ tîeh cṳ-nîe hùe thâu cū khap-lô̤h
en: if he sees a woman he hangs his head.

puj: i kò kâi nâng ió õi ngṳ̍t
puj_orig: i kò̤ kâi nâng ío ŏi ngṳ̂t
en: the people there have greater endurance.

puj: i kò kâi nâng mâng tsãi
puj_orig: i kò̤ kâi nâng mâng căi
en: the people there are very barbarous.

en: in making their houses, they take a bamboo, split it, dig out the knots, and lay on the half cylinders thus made, in the place of tiles.
What does he charge you with?
he has not made a complete estimate of the whole.

puj: i kòu nâng khṳ̀ liô si
puj_orig: i kò nâng khṳ̀ lîo si
en: they hired people to go and dredge for the corpse.

puj: i kôu chiah eng khṳ̀ pàng

en: he has ten thousand dollars of his personal funds remaining.

puj: i tshūe khṳ̀ ũ hẽ-lo̍h a bo?5
puj_orig: i chūe khṳ̀ ŭ hĕ-lô̤h a bô̤?
en: Did he by searching get any knowledge of the facts?
she bent down and peeped in.
he is not at all anxious.

puj: i tsn̂g kâi bô kiaⁿ bô iâⁿ
puj_orig: i cn̂g kâi bô̤ kiaⁿ bô̤ îaⁿ

en: he has a very poor memory.

puj: i tsn̂g kâi m̄ hió sì-chhêng
puj_orig: i cn̂g kâi m̄ hío sì-chêng
en: he does not at all understand the circumstances in the case.

puj: i tsn̂g kâi m̄ thoung chhêng
puj_orig: i cn̂g kâi m̄ thong chêng
en: he does not at all understand the state of affairs.

puj: i tsn̂g kâi nóⁿ-jia̍k tsai,6 bô ēng
puj_orig: i cn̂g kâi nó̤ⁿ-jîak căi, bô̤ ēng
en: he is altogether infirm of purpose, and good for nothing.

puj: i tsn̂g kâi tàⁿ m̄ tie̍h uē nek,5 tou sĩ hu-iẽn kâi uē
puj_orig: i cn̂g kâi tàⁿ m̄ tîeh ūe nêk, to sĭ hu-ĭen kâi ūe
en: he does not get at the gist of the subject at all, but expatiates without making the matter any clearer.

puj: i tsoung ji̍t huâng-huâng khip-khip,1 tou sĩ ēng kang
puj_orig: i cong jît hûang-hûang khip-khip, to sĭ ēng kang
en: he gives earnest heed the whole day long, and is very diligent.

puj: i tsoung-kú chip miⁿ,5 m̄ ngõ
puj_orig: i cong-kú cip mîⁿ, m̄ ngŏ̤
en: he holds persistently to that which possesses him, and will not shake it off; he is stolidly and willfully dull.

puj: i tsoung-kú iêⁿ-ieⁿ,5 bõi kit phí
puj_orig: i cong-kú îeⁿ-îeⁿ, bŏi kit phí
en: it always remains raw, and never scabs over.
he is always coming and annoying me.
he is all the time coming and involving us in his affairs.

puj: i tsoung-kú phah oh sĩ ũ pēⁿ
puj_orig: i cong-kú phah o̤h sĭ ŭ pēⁿ
en: if he belches continually, he is surely ill.

puj: i tsoung-kú àiⁿ khṳ̀ si̍p i
puj_orig: i cong-kú àiⁿ khṳ̀ sîp i
en: he is always wanting to make a sly attack on them.

puj: i tsoung-sin siẽⁿ tie̍h khueh hãm
puj_orig: i cong-sin sĭeⁿ tîeh khueh hăm
en: he regretted it all his life.

puj: i tsun mn̂g tsò chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄
puj_orig: i cwn mn̂g cò̤ cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄
en: he makes a specialty of this business.

puj: i tsun sim tsun ì tsò
puj_orig: i cwn sim cwn ì cò̤

puj: i tsun tó kio i sie khiò
puj_orig: i cwn tó̤ kio i sie khìo
en: he is intentionally acting in opposition to him.
he makes a business of copying out dispatches.

puj: i tsun tó tsoi̍h ôi-mīn-thiap bōi nâng
puj_orig: i cwn tó̤ côih ôi-mīn-thiap bōi nâng
en: his business is solely that of cutting out the stiffening of the uppers, and selling them.
he especially wishes it to be made thus.
he treats him within the respect due a superior.

puj: i tsá kùa ũ lâi me?7
puj_orig: i cá kùa ŭ lâi mē?

puj: i tsá mêⁿ bõi ut,5 tshang che̍k mêⁿ
puj_orig: i cá mêⁿ bŏi ût, chang cêk mêⁿ
en: he could not sleep last night, and moaned all night.
he is cornered; he has no place of escape.

puj: i tsáu ji̍p chhim suaⁿ nâ lãi khṳ̀ tiàm
puj_orig: i cáu jîp chim suaⁿ nâ lăi khṳ̀ tìam
en: he ran and hid in the woods among the mountains.
he went off to shirk the hard work.

puj: i tsáu kàu siâm-lô khṳ̀ lió
puj_orig: i cáu kàu sîam-lô̤ khṳ̀ lío
en: he has run off as far as Jericho by this time.
How can he do anything to prevent me?

puj: i tsò chiaⁿ,3 i tsò phien
puj_orig: i cò̤ cìaⁿ, i cò̤ phien
en: the one acts fairly, the other selfishly.

puj: i tsò chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ sĩ uá thâi-kṳ́ i kâi
puj_orig: i cò̤ cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ sĭ úa thâi-kṳ́ i kâi
en: it was I who recommended him for this.

puj: i tsò i bô iãng bô iãng
puj_orig: i cò̤ i bô̤ ĭang bô̤ ĭang

puj: i tsò i tó liâng sio sũi
puj_orig: i cò̤ i tó̤ lîang sio sŭi
en: he takes things very comfortably; he does not disturb himself about it.
How can he willingly injure people?

puj: i tsò khṳ̀ ió sũn sì
puj_orig: i cò̤ khṳ̀ ío sŭn sì

en: he has done it in the most painstaking manner.
he has done it in a most workmanlike manner.
he has made a good counterfeit.

puj: i tsò lâi put pui,1 put khang,3 khap-khap ha̍h lói
puj_orig: i cò̤ lâi put pui, put khàng, khap-khap hâh lói
en: he was neither obsequious nor arrogant, but simply polite.

puj: i tsò lṳ́ tsū mién tsò
puj_orig: i cò̤ lṳ́ cū míen cò̤
en: if he does it then you need not.

puj: i tsò mih sṳ̄ kha lâi chhiú lâi
puj_orig: i cò̤ mih sṳ̄ kha lâi chíu lâi
en: in whatever he does, he makes his hands and feet fly.

puj: i tsò mih sṳ̄ káⁿ chìn tsôiⁿ
puj_orig: i cò̤ mih sṳ̄ káⁿ cìn côiⁿ
en: in whatever he does he exerts himself.

puj: i tsò mih sṳ̄ sĩ ũ káng ũ kiu,3 bô thèng tsò
puj_orig: i cò̤ mih sṳ̄ sĭ ŭ káng ŭ kìu, bô̤ thèng cò̤
en: in whatever he does he informs himself in regard to the way it ought to be done, and does not act heedlessly.

puj: i tsò mih sṳ̄ tou sĩ khin kha khoi̍h chhiu,2 tsṳ̃-sòi tsãi
puj_orig: i cò̤ mih sṳ̄ to sĭ khin kha khôih chíu, cṳ̆-sòi căi
en: he does everything very gently, and is exceedingly careful.

puj: i tsò mih sṳ̄ tou sĩ phû-chhêng tshàu-khì
puj_orig: i cò̤ mih sṳ̄ to sĭ phû-chêng chàu-khì
en: his conduct is always frivolous and mean.

puj: i tsò mih sṳ̄ tou ũ kâi tiāⁿ khî
puj_orig: i cò̤ mih sṳ̄ to ŭ kâi tīaⁿ khî
en: he has a set time for everything he does.

puj: i tsò m̄ pat tò khṳ̀
puj_orig: i cò̤ m̄ pat tò̤ khṳ̀
en: he does not know how to do it.

puj: i tsò nî káⁿ môung-ûi put khúi
puj_orig: i cò̤ nî káⁿ mông-ûi put khúi
en: how dare he scheme for what is treasonable?
he sits very quietly and decorously.
he is very set in his ways.

puj: i tsò sṳ̃ ió ũ pá-thî
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̆ ío ŭ pá-thî
en: he acts with greater firmness in the management of affairs.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ bô huap bô lu̍t
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ bô̤ huap bô̤ lût
en: he acts without any regard to rules or regulations; he is perfectly lawless.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ bô hun bô hió
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ bô̤ hun bô̤ hío

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ bô hun tshùn
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ bò̤ hun chùn

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ bô kòi bô môung
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ bô̤ kòi bô̤ mông
en: he has no underhand schemes in what he does.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ bô liû sim
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ bô̤ lîu sim
en: he does not fix his mind on what he is doing.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ bô sìn bô si̍t
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ bô̤ sìn bô̤ sît

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ bô tiāⁿ keⁿ
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ bô̤ tīaⁿ keⁿ
en: he acts in an irresolute way.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ bô tsú bô ì
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ bô̤ cú bô̤ ì
en: he acts without any fixed purpose.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ huâng-huâng khip-khip,1 khṳ̂n-kṳ́n tsãi
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ hûang-hûang khip-khip, khṳ̂n-kṳ́n căi
en: he does things heedfully, and is very earnest and attentive.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ ió chiũ lí
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ ío cĭu lí
en: he is regardful of the right in what he does.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ ió ũ kiaⁿ sim
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ ío ŭ kiaⁿ sim

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ ióng- iak tsãi
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ íong- iak căi

en: he acts with scrupulous regard to truth.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ khah jĩm sèⁿ
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ khah jĭm sèⁿ
en: he gives way to his temper too much.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ khah pang,1 i tsò sṳ̄ ió îⁿ
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ khah pang, i cò̤ sṳ̄ ío îⁿ
en: this one does things more precisely, the other does them the more accommodatingly.
he acts in a very eccentric manner.
he does things in a very painstaking way.
she does things in a very slovenly way.
his course of action is easily changed by expediency or constraint.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ m̄ chheng,5 m̄ ngũn
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ m̄ chêng, m̄ ngw̆n

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ m̄ káⁿ pāi tie̍h mn̂g-huang
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ m̄ káⁿ pāi tîeh mn̂g-huang
en: his conduct shows care not to disgrace the family name.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ phû-phû hùam-huam,3 m̄ tie̍h si̍t
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ phû-phû hùam-hùam, m̄ tîeh sît
en: he does things very superficially, and is never thorough.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ sĩm sĩ khúi-khiet
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ sĭm sĭ khúi-khiet
en: he acts in such a way as to gain his ends by guile.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ sĩm sĩ kãu tãu
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ sĭm sĭ kău tău

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ sĩm sĩ tūa pāng
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ sĭm sĭ tōa pāng
en: he does things on a very large scale.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ thua nî thua tsúi
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ thoa nî thoa cúi
en: he does a thing as if he were being dragged to it through mud and water.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tou bô kù náu-tài
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ to bô̤ kù náu-tài
en: he takes no thought for his own head, in what he is doing.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tou m̄ chiò lí
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ to m̄ cìo lí
en: he always acts contrary to reason.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tou m̄ tsṳ̃ tõung
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ to m̄ cṳ̆ tŏng
en: he does things in a way that reflects no credit on himself.
en_orig: he does things is a way that reflects no credit on himself.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tou sĩ huâng-huâng khióng-khiong,2 kiaⁿ-ùi tsò tāⁿ
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ to sĭ hûang-hûang khíong-khíong, kiaⁿ-ùi cò̤ tāⁿ
en: she does things in a flurry, fearful that she will do them wrongly.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tou sĩ kóu-kóu chhiáⁿ-chhiáⁿ
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ to sĭ kó-kó chíaⁿ-chíaⁿ
en: he always does things in a very off-hand style.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tou sĩ lak-lak thak-thak
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ to sĭ lak-lak thak-thak
en: she does things in a very slovenly way.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tou sĩ ma-ma hu-hu
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ to sĭ ma-ma hu-hu
en: whatever he does he produces very unsatisfactory results.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tou sĩ tshuang-tshuang tsuãng-tsuãng i,1 tshûn bô kèng i lãu-tua
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ to sĭ chuang-chuang cŭang-cŭang i, chŵn bô̤ kèng i lău-toa
en: he is all the time acting contrary to his views, and pays no regard to him as his senior.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tou sĩ u̍t lí u̍t huap
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ to sĭ ŵt lí ŵt huap
en: he transgresses the laws all the time.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tsn̂g kâi m̄ kúaⁿ-kut
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ cn̂g kâi m̄ kúaⁿ-kwt

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ tūa tsú tūa ì
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ tōa cú tōa ì

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ uá thóiⁿ tie̍h m̄ koung-tãu
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ úa thóiⁿ tîeh m̄ kong-tău
en: he acts in a way that appears to me to bo unfair.

puj: i tsò sṳ̄ ũ thâu ũ búe
puj_orig: i cò̤ sṳ̄ ŭ thâu ŭ búe
en: he does things in a systematic manner.
he is the linguist employed in the transaction of business.

puj: i tsò to m̄ tiām-tiām tso,3 tou ũ hùaⁿ kâi khue-kâi
puj_orig: i cò̤ to̤ m̄ tīam-tīam cò̤, to ŭ hùaⁿ kâi khue-kâi
en: he does not keep steadily at his work, but is all the time making sport.
he made a mistake in doing it.

puj: i tsò-ni̤ m̄ tì kâi ke-au?6
puj_orig: i cò̤-ni̤ m̄ tì kâi ke-ău?
en: Why does he not get a wife?

puj: i tsò-nî che̍k lōu thiû-thû kàu chièⁿ kú hûn būe lai?5
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî cêk lō thîu-thû kàu cièⁿ kú hŵn būe lâi?
en: How is it that he has delayed on the road so long and has not yet arrived?
Why is he screaming so wildly?

puj: i tsò-nî chia̍h kàn hièⁿ sou?3
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî cîah kàn hìeⁿ sò?

en: What is she bustling about so for?

puj: i tsò-nî jĩm hàm m̄ bûa piⁿ?1
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî jĭm hàm m̄ bûa piⁿ?
en: Why does he not come when he is called?
What does he say about it?

puj: i tsò-nî kiu-kiu niu-niu,1 tsn̂g kâi m̄ tshun-tshṳ?1
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî kiu-kiu niu-niu, cn̂g kâi m̄ chun-chṳ?
en: Why is it that he is bent down double, and does does not straighten himself up at all?
How dare he resist the magistrate?
How dare he oppose him by force?

puj: i tsò-nî káⁿ kiú chèng hãi-tou?3
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî káⁿ kíu cèng hăi-tò?
en: How dare he lead the people into a feud?

puj: i tsò-nî káⁿ siẽn-tsṳ̃ thiah huang?1
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî káⁿ sĭen-cṳ̆ thiah huang?
en: How dare he take the responsibility of opening the envelope without orders?

puj: i tsò-nî maiⁿ,3 sĩ kiè-sĩ i tsò-ni?5
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî màiⁿ, sĭ kìe-sĭ i cò̤-nî?
en: Why does he not want it, what does he say is the matter with it?
What is the reason he does not eat?

puj: i tsò-nî m̄ khéng kiù i?1
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî m̄ khéng kìu i?
en: Why will he not render him any help?

puj: i tsò-nî m̄ kù ka-ki,7 tuaⁿ kù pa̍t nâng
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî m̄ kù ka-kī, toaⁿ kù pât nâng
en: why does he not take care of himself, as well as of other people.

puj: i tsò-nî m̄-ùi tūa nâng meⁿ?7
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî m̄-ùi tōa nâng mēⁿ?
en: How is it that she does not fear the scolding she will get from the elders in her family?

puj: i tsò-nî nih kha nih kha,1 m̄ káⁿ kiâⁿ tūa huah?5
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî nih kha nih kha, m̄ káⁿ kîaⁿ tōa hûah?
en: Why does he walk so carefully, not venturing to take long steps?

puj: i tsò-nî phah uá sái khṳ̀ kâi nang?5
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî phah úa sái khṳ̀ kâi nâng?
en: Why did he beat my messenger?

puj: i tsò-nî put-siak thàng i kâi chiⁿ?5
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî put-siak thàng i kâi cîⁿ?
en: Why does he hold aloof from earning this money?

puj: i tsò-nî taⁿ,3 lṳ́ piâⁿ uá thiaⁿ
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî tàⁿ, lṳ́ pîaⁿ úa thiaⁿ
en: repeat his words to me as nearly as you can.

puj: i tsò-nî tin-tò lâi kuài lṳ?2
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî tin-tò̤ lâi kùai lṳ́?
en: Why does he turn about and blame you?

puj: i tsò-nî tiām-tiam,7 m̄ khui tshui?3
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî tīam-tīam, m̄ khui chùi?
en: Why does he remain silent, and not open his mouth?

puj: i tsò-nî tsoung-kú siẽⁿ chhit siẽⁿ poih?1
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî cong-kú sĭeⁿ chit sĭeⁿ poih?
en: Why does ho always borrow trouble about things?

puj: i tsò-nî tsu bu,6 tsn̂g kâi bô kui bô moⁿ?5
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî cu bŭ, cn̂g kâi bô̤ kui bô̤ mô̤ⁿ?
en: Why is it that in all sorts of affairs, he follows no rules nor precedents?

puj: i tsò-nî tsò sṳ̄ bô hun bô hio?2
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî cò̤ sṳ̄ bô̤ huu bô̤ hío?
en: Why does he act without discrimination?
How did he happen to fail in it?

puj: i tsò-nî àiⁿ lâi tîⁿ-jió lṳ?2
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî àiⁿ lâi tîⁿ-jío lṳ́?
en: Why should he come and harass you?

puj: i tsò-nî ṳn chiang chhiu po?3
puj_orig: i cò̤-nî ṳn ciang chiu pò̤?
en: Why does he requite good with evil?

puj: i tsóu pat tsò kùe thài-uè
puj_orig: i có pat cò̤ kùe thài-ùe
en: his grandfather held at one time an ancient office which is now filled by a governor.

puj: i tsôiⁿ seⁿ tsôiⁿ sì sĩ tsò chek ak
puj_orig: i côiⁿ seⁿ côiⁿ sì sĭ cò̤ cek ak
en: his sins in a former life were numerous.

puj: i tsôiⁿ tiang-sî pat tiam kùe i kâi ṳn
puj_orig: i côiⁿ tiang-sî pat tiam kùe i kâi ṳn
en: he had formerly experienced his kindness.

puj: i tsõ huâng-tì ūi tsõ jie̍h tsōi ni?5
puj_orig: i cŏ̤ hûang-tì ūi cŏ̤ jîeh cōi nî?
en: For how many years did he sit upon the throne?

puj: i tsõ lió huah-hì huah-hãi sĩ nâng khùn-kũn ma̍k-siap,1 a sĩ hun-ngien?3
puj_orig: i cŏ̤ lío huah-hì huah-hăi sĭ nâng khùn-kw̆n mâk-siap, a sĭ hun-ngìen?
en: Having sat down he keeps yawning: is it from the sleepiness produced by fatigue, or is it because the time for him to take his opium has come?

puj: i tsõ pàng ko thóiⁿ tie̍h lêng-gūa
puj_orig: i cŏ̤ pàng ko̤ thóiⁿ tîeh lêng-gūa

puj: i tsõ pàng kò oi-oi uá-uá
puj_orig: i cŏ̤ pàng kò̤ oi-oi úa-úa
en: he lounges about when he sits.

puj: i tsõ tou m̄ tiām tso,6 kha tõung chhiú hìⁿ
puj_orig: i cŏ̤ to m̄ tiām cŏ̤, kha tŏng chíu hìⁿ
en: when he sits down he never sits still, but keeps flopping his limps about.

puj: i tsõ tõ iâng kiē teng,3 chhēng kũa phi-koiⁿ,1 tì kũa chiak-téng
puj_orig: i cŏ̤ tŏ̤ îang kīe tèng, chēng kŭa phi-koiⁿ, tì kŭa ciak-téng
