puj_orig: lṳ́ hó̤ chòiⁿ i nā kò̤
en: you should urge him to stay there.

puj: lṳ́ hóung lṳ́ louk,5 mîn ko mîn chiⁿ hiã mîn kōi ngiak,5 siãng-thiⁿ lâng khi
puj_orig: lṳ́ hóng lṳ́ lôk, mîn ko̤ mîn ciⁿ hĭa mîn kōi ngîak, sĭang-thiⁿ lâng khi
en: your salary and perquisites are the people’s substance: the common people are easily oppressed, but God is not to be imposed upon.
Why do you take so much trouble?

puj: lṳ́ hô m̄ tsá chē lai?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ hô̤ m̄ cá cē lâi?
en: Why did you not come earlier?
What means of knowing have you?

puj: lṳ́ hô-íⁿ kièn tit sĩ chièⁿ-seⁿ?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ hô̤-íⁿ kìen tit sĭ cìeⁿ-seⁿ?
en: How could you know it would be so?

puj: lṳ́ hûaⁿ kàu uá bõi u̍t
puj_orig: lṳ́ hûaⁿ kàu úa bŏi ût
en: you snore so that I cannot sleep.

puj: lṳ́ hāi tie̍h uá kâi sṳ̄
puj_orig: lṳ́ hāi tîeh úa kâi sṳ̄

puj: lṳ́ hāiⁿ-hāiⁿ-kiè sī ûi tie̍h sĩm-mih sṳ?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ hāiⁿ-hāiⁿ-kìe sī ûi tîeh sĭm-mih sṳ̄?

en: How do you know that I do not want it?

puj: lṳ́ it it tàⁿ uá tsai
puj_orig: lṳ́ it it tàⁿ úa cai
en: you tell me about them, item by item.
lay it up in your mind and remember it.
you take a look at it and see what sort of things it is.
your opinion is of greater value.

puj: lṳ́ ió kiêⁿ kùe i,1 haⁿ?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ ío kîeⁿ kùe i, háⁿ?
en: You are superior to him, are you?
you have had a wider experience.

puj: lṳ́ iā m̄ sòi tshak tsū m̄ tsai
puj_orig: lṳ́ īa m̄ sòi chak cū m̄ cai
en: if you do not scrutinize it carefully you will not know.

puj: lṳ́ iā àiⁿ khṳ̀ li uá àiⁿ kià-hṳ̄ lṳ́ nõ kṳ̀ uē
puj_orig: lṳ́ īa àiⁿ khṳ̀ li úa àiⁿ kìa-hṳ̄ lṳ́ nŏ̤ kṳ̀ ūe
en: if you are going I want to entrust a short message to you to carry.

puj: lṳ́ jû-kúaⁿ àiⁿ lâi li thùa-tsah lâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ jû-kúaⁿ àiⁿ lâi li thòa-cah lâi
en: if you should be coming, bring it along with you.
you go and do it yourself.

puj: lṳ́ kah uá m̄ tâng kouk
puj_orig: lṳ́ kah úa m̄ tâng kok
en: you and I are not of the same country.

puj: lṳ́ kah uá tsò-pû lâi khṳ̀
puj_orig: lṳ́ kah úa cò̤-pû lâi khṳ̀

puj: lṳ́ kang-khóu tie̍h jû-kèng kiãng-khí chì
puj_orig: lṳ́ kang-khó tîeh jû-kèng kĭang-khí cì
en: if in difficulty, you must be the more determined.

puj: lṳ́ khak-khóu tso,3 tsò kàu hó-hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ khak-khó cò̤, cò̤ kàu hó̤-hó̤
en: you persevere in doing it, and do it very nicely.

puj: lṳ́ khie̍h khṳ̀ siêⁿ thóiⁿ hó a m̄-hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ khîeh khṳ̀ sîeⁿ thóiⁿ hó̤ a m̄-hó̤
en: you take it and try it and see whether it is good or not.

puj: lṳ́ khip khui,3 khip kàu tn̂g-tng,5 thóiⁿ lṳ́ kâi hùi tī-kò õi thiàⁿ a bõi
puj_orig: lṳ́ khip khùi, khip kàu tn̂g-tn̂g, thoíⁿ lṳ́ kâi hùi tī-kò̤ ŏi thìaⁿ a bŏi
en: draw a very long breath, and see whether there is a pain in any part of your lungs.

puj: lṳ́ khiâ êⁿ to boi,6 phah tú tsū õi
puj_orig: lṳ́ khîa êⁿ to̤ bŏi, phah tú cū ŏi
en: you cannot raise the heavy beams, but you can put the props under.
you think it over at your leisure.

puj: lṳ́ khṳt tī-tiâng khau kàu hièⁿ tsōi leh?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳt tī-tîang khau kàu hìeⁿ cōi lêh?
en: Who has scratched you like that?

puj: lṳ́ khṳt uá tsò kiáⁿ ió khah sòi
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳt úa cò̤ kíaⁿ ío khah sòi
en: you are too young even to be my child.
you go and experiment upon it.

puj: lṳ́ khṳ̀ hièⁿ ku,1 khṳ̀ tì-kou?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳ̀ hìeⁿ ku, khṳ̀ tì-kò?
en: Where have you been, that you have been gone so long?

puj: lṳ́ khṳ̀ kau,3 màiⁿ tsháng i khah thiám
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳ̀ kàu, màiⁿ cháng i khah thíam
en: when you get there, do not overbear him too completely.

puj: lṳ́ khṳ̀ kio uá tsò hó-hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳ̀ kio úa cò̤ hó̤-hó̤
en: you go and do it nicely for me.
you go and see how much force there is to be overcome.

puj: lṳ́ khṳ̀ kàu tie̍h kio i kìⁿ lói
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳ̀ kàu tîeh kio i kìⁿ lói
en: when you arrive you must go and pay your respects to him.

puj: lṳ́ khṳ̀ kìⁿ kuaⁿ,1 i ā-sĩ hàm lṳ́ kâi miâⁿ lṳ́ tsū ìn tàⁿ “iuⁿ”2
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳ̀ kìⁿ kuaⁿ, i ā-sĭ hàm lṳ́ kâi mîaⁿ lṳ́ cū ìn tàⁿ “íuⁿ”
en: when you go before a magistrate, if your name is called you reply “Here”.
How many times did you go?

puj: lṳ́ khṳ̀ lio,2 sĩ tsò-ni,5 lâi hûe-houk uá tsai
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳ̀ lío, sĭ cò̤-nî, lâi hûe-hok úa cai
en: after having gone, whatever the result, return and bring me word.
you go and verify it by inspection.

puj: lṳ́ khṳ̀ thoiⁿ,2 thóiⁿ sĩm-mih kèⁿ-lō
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳ̀ thóiⁿ, thóiⁿ sĭm-mih kèⁿ-lō̤
en: you go and see what sort of path there is.

puj: lṳ́ khṳ̀ thèng loung,6 lõung thóiⁿ õi tit sêng mē
puj_orig: lṳ́ khṳ̀ thèng lŏng, lŏng thóiⁿ ŏi tit sêng mē
en: you go and make some attempts at doing it, and see whether it can be done.
you go and let him know.
Whose school do you attend this year?

puj: lṳ́ kio i ió siang ho,2 uá thoh lṳ́ kio i tàⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ kio i ío siang hó̤, úa tho̤h lṳ́ kio i tàⁿ
en: you are quite intimate with him, and so I will leave it to you to tell him.

puj: lṳ́ kio i sĩ sie kāng che̍k kâi a-bó a sĩ kak nâng kak nâng kai?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ kio i sĭ sie kāng cêk kâi a-bó̤ a sĭ kak nâng kak nâng kâi?
en: Have you and he the same, or different mothers?

puj: lṳ́ kio i ũ sĩm-mih kue-kuah?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ kio i ŭ sĭm-mih kue-kuah?
en: What is your relationship to him?

puj: lṳ́ kio uá chhiáⁿ i lâi tàⁿ uē
puj_orig: lṳ́ kio úa chíaⁿ i lâi tàⁿ ūe
en: you ask him for me to come and have a chat.

puj: lṳ́ kio uá liàm hó-ho,2 màiⁿ ngàn tie̍h
puj_orig: lṳ́ kio úa lìam hó̤-hó̤, màiⁿ ngàn tîeh
en: pinch me softly, and not so hard as to hurt.

puj: lṳ́ kio uá lo̍h kâi niá
puj_orig: lṳ́ kio úa lô̤h kâi nía
en: you put on the collar for me.

puj: lṳ́ kio uá lêng-uāⁿ tsò kâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ kio úa lêng-ūaⁿ cò̤ kâi

puj: lṳ́ kio uá thie ki tshuaⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ kio úa thie ki chuaⁿ
en: you pick out this sliver for me.
have it charged in your account for me.

puj: lṳ́ kio uá tàⁿ lio,2 uá chiàⁿ kio lṳ́ tàⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ kio úa tàⁿ lío, úa cìaⁿ kio lṳ́ tàⁿ
en: you tell me, and then I will tell you.
tell me tho truth about it.

puj: lṳ́ kiàⁿ khṳ̀ õi he̍k a boi?6
puj_orig: lṳ́ kìaⁿ khṳ̀ ŏi hêk a bŏi?

puj: lṳ́ kiá-jû àiⁿ lâi li soiⁿ tàⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ kía-jû àiⁿ lâi li soiⁿ tàⁿ
en: should you make up your mind to come, then let us know beforehand.
How much younger are you than he?
do not swagger when you walk.
Will you venture to eat it?

puj: lṳ́ káⁿ kāng i chiù-tsūa me?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ káⁿ kāng i cìu-cūa mē?
en: Dare you call down the wrath of a god upon you if he be right and you wrong?

puj: lṳ́ káⁿ peh-chiẽⁿ thah téng me?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ káⁿ peh-cĭeⁿ thah téng mē?
en: Would you venture to climb to the top of the pagoda?

puj: lṳ́ káⁿ thiaⁿ uá tsū hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ káⁿ thiaⁿ úa cū hó̤
en: if you will venture to follow my advice, all will be well.

puj: lṳ́ kâi chhiu lâu khí lai,5 õi kùe liâm
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chiu lâu khí lâi, ŏi kùe lîam
en: if you let your beard grow, you will have a moustache.

puj: lṳ́ kâi chhiêⁿ àiⁿ kih tsng a àiⁿ cheng hue?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chîeⁿ àiⁿ kih cng a àiⁿ ceng hue?
en: Are you going to make your wall of bricks or of chunam?

puj: lṳ́ kâi chhiú nah-sap,1 khṳ̀ sói chheng-khih
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chíu nah-sap, khṳ̀ sói cheng-khih
en: your hands are dirty, go and wash them clean.

puj: lṳ́ kâi chhiú tie̍h tsoung-kú la,6 m̄ lã i tsū àiⁿ tùe ue
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chíu tîeh cong-kú lă, m̄ lă i cū àiⁿ tùe ue
en: you must keep stirring it up from the bottom with your hand, if you don't it will stick to the pot.

puj: lṳ́ kâi chhiú tsai jih,5 màiⁿ pun huang tshue tsáu
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chíu cai jîh, màiⁿ pun huang chue cáu
en: press your hand upon it, and do not let the wind blow it away.

puj: lṳ́ kâi chhiú-tūn pí i ió kau
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chíu-tw̄n pí i ío kau
en: your strength of arm is greater than his.

puj: lṳ́ kâi chhìn tie̍h téng hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chìn tîeh téng hó̤

puj: lṳ́ kâi chia̍h lió ũ ũi a bô ui?6
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi cîah lío ŭ ŭi a bô̤ ŭi?
en: Having eaten have you nothing useful to attend to?

puj: lṳ́ kâi chiú liãng ió kau,1 uāⁿ kâi chiú-cheng ió tūa kâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi cíu lĭang ío kau, ūaⁿ kâi cíu-ceng ío tōa kâi
en: you can take much wine without becoming intoxicated: change your cup for a larger one.

puj: lṳ́ kâi chi̍h khiò-phu;5 chi̍h tiè khiò
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi cîh khìo-phû; cîh tìe khìo

puj: lṳ́ kâi chi̍h tshun tshut lâi uá thóiⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi cîh chun chut lâi úa thóiⁿ
en: put out your tongue and let me look at it.

puj: lṳ́ kâi hun-ín khin,1 i kâi hun-ín tãng
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi hun-ín khin, i kâi hun-ín tăng
en: your opium habit is not so completely fixed upon you as his is upon him.

puj: lṳ́ kâi kha khiò-phû uá thóiⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kha khìo-phû úa thóiⁿ
en: lift up your foot and let me look at it.

puj: lṳ́ kâi kha m̄ tie̍h khiò-phû i chiàⁿ hó iã
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kha m̄ tîeh khìo-phû i cìaⁿ hó̤ ĭa
en: why don't you bend up your legs so that he can carry you on his back?

puj: lṳ́ kâi kha pōu khin,1 i kâi kha pōu tãng
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kha pō khin, i kâi kha pō tăng
en: your footsteps are light, his are heavy.

puj: lṳ́ kâi kha pōu màiⁿ kiâⁿ kàu hièⁿ tãng
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kha pō màiⁿ kîaⁿ kàu hìeⁿ tăng

puj: lṳ́ kâi khak tsò-nî pak,5 uá kói m̄ tshut?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi khak cò̤-nî pâk, úa kói m̄ chut?
en: How have you tied this knot, that I cannot untie it?

puj: lṳ́ kâi khau sĩ khieh tie̍h sĩm-mueh?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi khau sĭ khieh tîeh sĭm-mûeh?
en: What did you draw, as your lot?

puj: lṳ́ kâi kia tsak khie̍h lâi khṳt uá pài tha̍k chē
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kia cak khîeh lâi khṳt úa pài thâk cē
en: bring your elegant composition and allow me to respectfully read it.

puj: lṳ́ kâi kia tsak khie̍h lâi khṳt uá pài tha̍k chē
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kia cak khîeh lâi khṳt úa pài thâk cē
en: bring your elegant composition and let me have the reading of it.
you want every one of them.

puj: lṳ́ kâi kè kàu chí-kò lâi ũ sĩm-mih kùi kang?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kè kàu cí-kò̤ lâi ŭ sĭm-mih kùi kàng?
en: On what business does Your Excellency come?

puj: lṳ́ kâi kî hó niẽ i ũ che̍k lia̍p chí
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kî hó̤ nĭe i ŭ cêk lîap cí
en: in the game played you should give him a man.

puj: lṳ́ kâi kùi kè tiang-sî kau?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kùi kè tiang-sî kàu?

puj: lṳ́ kâi kùi tsãu sĩ sĩm-mih sî jit,5 sĩm-mih nî gueh?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kùi cău sĭ sĭm-mih sî jît, sĭm-mih nî gûeh?

puj: lṳ́ kâi kńg siá hó a bue?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi kńg sía hó̤ a būe?

puj: lṳ́ kâi lâm jiò àiⁿ ēng sĩm-mih hue-tsháu kai?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi lâm jìo àiⁿ ēng sĭm-mih hue-cháu kâi?
en: What sort of flowers do you want in your blue crape?

puj: lṳ́ kâi ma̍k miⁿ-miⁿ m̄ káⁿ tièⁿ khui sĩ khṳt sĩm-mih kâi eng tie̍h a m̄ si?6
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi mâk miⁿ-miⁿ m̄ káⁿ tìeⁿ khui sĭ khṳt sĭm-mih kâi eng tîeh a m̄ sĭ?
en: You shut your eyes and dare not open them because you have got something in them, is not that it?

puj: lṳ́ kâi ma̍k peh tūa chē
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi mâk peh tōa cē
en: open your eyes a little wider.

puj: lṳ́ kâi ma̍k tsù-tsù tó thóiⁿ sĩm-mueh?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi mâk cù-cù tó̤ thóiⁿ sĭm-mûeh?
en: What are you looking at so fixedly?

puj: lṳ́ kâi ma̍k-chiu bô thóiⁿ lou,7 tsò màiⁿ pua̍h tie̍h
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi mâk-ciu bô̤ thóiⁿ lō, cò̤ màiⁿ pûah tîeh
en: if you do not look where you are going, you cannot do otherwise than fall down.
your eyes are good for nothing.

puj: lṳ́ kâi miâⁿ kiè-tsò sĩm mueh?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi mîaⁿ kìe-cò̤ sĭm mûeh?

puj: lṳ́ kâi mn̂g tie̍h kun hó-hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi mn̂g tîeh kwn hó̤-hó̤
en: you must guard the doorway carefully.

puj: lṳ́ kâi mûeⁿ àiⁿ pû mîⁿ a pû khiu?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi mûeⁿ àiⁿ pû mîⁿ a pû khīu?
en: Do you want your congee boiled much or little?

puj: lṳ́ kâi ne̍k sĩ chiẽⁿ a m̄ si,6 lṳ́ tó tshūe phah?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi nêk sĭ cĭeⁿ a m̄ sĭ, lṳ́ tó̤ chūe phah?
en: You are itching for a thrashing are you not?

puj: lṳ́ kâi ne̍k tó chiẽⁿ lio!1
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi nêk tó̤ cĭeⁿ lio!
en: You itch for want of a whipping!

puj: lṳ́ kâi pang àiⁿ ēng jie̍h kãu kai?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi pang àiⁿ ēng jîeh kău kâi?
en: How thick do you want your boards to be?

puj: lṳ́ kâi phoi-taⁿ lāng ji̍p lâi khṳt i chih
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi phoi-taⁿ lāng jîp lâi khṳt i cih
en: reach your carrying pole in and let her take it.

puj: lṳ́ kâi phǔe m̄-hó kám thâu kám hia̍h
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi phǔe m̄-hó̤ kám thâu kám hîah
en: do not cover your head with your coverlet.

puj: lṳ́ kâi piⁿ khûn tõ ko,3 tie̍h tsai pàng lo̍h lâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi piⁿ khŵn tŏ̤ kò̤, tîeh cai pàng lô̤h lâi
en: your queue is wound around your head, you must remember and let it down.

puj: lṳ́ kâi saⁿ lâm tie̍h iû
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi saⁿ lâm tîeh îu
en: your tunic is splashed with oil.

puj: lṳ́ kâi saⁿ tsò õi kâi chiah kâi chiah?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi saⁿ cò̤ ŏi kâi ciah kâi ciah?
en: Why is your jacket spotted like that?
do not be uneasy in your mind.

puj: lṳ́ kâi sin-hun ngan,5 m̄ hó chia̍h chhìn tsúi
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi sin-hun ngân, m̄ hó̤ cîah chìn cúi
en: the temperature of your body is low, and you should not drink cold water.

puj: lṳ́ kâi sin-hūn liang,5 tie̍h chia̍h tsò bí-kam-te,5 m̄ hó chia̍h tê hie̍h
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi sin-hūn lîang, tîeh cîah cò̤ bí-kam-tê, m̄ hó̤ cîah tê hîeh
en: your system is depleted, and you must drink coffee made from browned rice, you should not drink tea.

puj: lṳ́ kâi sin-hūn tie̍h tsai thiô-iáng
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi sin-hūn tîeh cai thîo-íang

puj: lṳ́ kâi sìn mīn tèng kio uá siá “móng nâng uaⁿ khi;”2
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi sìn mīn tèng kio úa sía “móng nâng uaⁿ khí;”
en: write for me on the outside the letter, the superscription, “may you open it in peace.”

puj: lṳ́ kâi sṳ̄ lí kàu i iap-thiap iap-thiap
en: do up your work very neatly.

puj: lṳ́ kâi tsam kit pàng tĩ-ko?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi cam kit pàng tĭ-kò̤?
en: Where have you stuck your needle?

puj: lṳ́ kâi tsang ũ chiap tsáng a bo?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi cang ŭ ciap cáng a bô̤?

puj: lṳ́ kâi tshùi chi̍h màiⁿ khah kín
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chùi cîh màiⁿ khah kín
en: do not be in too great haste to begin to eat.

puj: lṳ́ kâi tshùi kâm sǐm-mue̍h tǒ?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chùi kâm sǐm-mûeh tǒ̤?
en: What have you got in your mouth?

puj: lṳ́ kâi tshùi peh khuah,1 uá thóiⁿ lṳ́ kâi chi̍h tsãi-seⁿ-iēⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chùi peh khuah, úa thóiⁿ lṳ́ kâi cîh căi-seⁿ-īeⁿ
en: open your mouth wide so that I can see the condition of your tongue.

puj: lṳ́ kâi tshùi ãm sĩm-mih mue̍h to?6
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chùi ăm sĭm-mih mûeh tŏ̤?
en: What have you got in your mouth?

puj: lṳ́ kâi tshùi ôi hue-nio a boi?6
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi chùi ôi hue-nio a bŏi?
en: Do you tell the exact truth, or not?

puj: lṳ́ kâi táu-kài tie̍h khiâ hó-hó chiàⁿ ũ tsún
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi táu-kài tîeh khîa hó̤-hó̤ cìaⁿ ŭ cún
en: hold your bushel scraper rightly and then there will be fair measure given.

puj: lṳ́ kâi tūa miâⁿ uá būe chêng chhiáⁿ kà
puj_orig: lṳ́ kaî tōa mîaⁿ úa būe cêng chíaⁿ kà
en: I have not yet asked your name.

puj: lṳ́ kâi uē màiⁿ tàⁿ khah hùam-lãm
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi ūe màiⁿ tàⁿ khah hùam-lăm
en: do not deluge us with your words.

puj: lṳ́ kâi uē sĩ pńg tiàm tsṳ̃ tsãu
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi ūe sĭ pńg tìam cṳ̆ cău
en: this is story which you yourself make up.

puj: lṳ́ kâi uē tàⁿ lâi m̄ kah koi-chhĩ
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi m̄ kah koi-chĭ
en: what you say is not in accordance with the recognized rules of trade here.

puj: lṳ́ kâi uē tàⁿ lâi tshûn bõi tshò
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi ūe tàⁿ lâi chŵn bŏi chò̤

puj: lṳ́ kâi àiⁿ ka tsò tūa tâng a sĩ ka tsò khih khim?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi àiⁿ ka cò̤ tōa tâng a sĭ ka cò̤ khih khim?
en: Do you want yours cut so as to button under the arm, or half way between the front and the left shoulder?

puj: lṳ́ kâi ì sĩ àiⁿ tsò-ni?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi ì sĭ àiⁿ cò̤-nî?
en: What is your idea about it?

puj: lṳ́ kâi ũ ũi a bo?5 àiⁿ mue̍h tiō i mih sṳ?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ kâi ŭ ŭi a bô̤? àiⁿ mûeh tīo i mih sṳ̄?
en: Have you nothing better than that do to? What did you want to spoil it for?
you point it out to me.
you make a guess at the value.

puj: lṳ́ kóu thóiⁿ chiá sṳ̄ õi tit sêng me?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ kó thóiⁿ cía sṳ̄ ŏi tit sêng mē?
en: Do you think this can be brought about?

puj: lṳ́ lai,5 uá àiⁿ hun-hù lṳ́ kâi uē
puj_orig: lṳ́ lâi, úa àiⁿ hun-hù lṳ́ kâi ūe
en: come here, I have something I wish to direct you about.

puj: lṳ́ le,1 put pí pa̍t nâng
puj_orig: lṳ́ le, put pí pât nâng
en: being you, it is not the same as if it were another person.

puj: lṳ́ li kau ua,2 uá li kau i
puj_orig: lṳ́ li kau úa, úa li kau i
en: you delivered it over to me, and I handed it over to him.

puj: lṳ́ li kèng nang,5 nâng li kèng lṳ́
puj_orig: lṳ́ li kèng nâng, nâng li kèng lṳ́
en: treat others respectfully, and others will treat you respectfully.
What do you make it, in your estimate of it?

puj: lṳ́ liām che̍k pìn uá thiaⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ līam cêk pìn úa thiaⁿ
en: you recite it once for me to hear.

puj: lṳ́ louk thóiⁿ hṳ́ tói ũ tê-hie̍h a bô
puj_orig: lṳ́ lok thóiⁿ hṳ́ tói ŭ tê-hîeh a bô̤
en: you shake it and see if there is any dry tea in it.

puj: lṳ́ lâi cheng,1 uá lâi thai
puj_orig: lṳ́ lâi ceng, úa lâi thai
en: you pound and I will sift.

puj: lṳ́ lâi tsõ pàng uá sin-piⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ lâi cŏ̤ pàng úa sin-piⁿ

puj: lṳ́ lâi uá ko,3 uá li khṳ̀ lṳ́ kò
puj_orig: lṳ́ lâi úa kò̤, úa li khṳ̀ lṳ́ kò̤
en: you came to my house, and I went to yours.
give some consideration to my welfare.

puj: lṳ́ lãu nâng kâi khì-thói khang-kiẽn tsãi
puj_orig: lṳ́ lău nâng kâi khì-thói khang-kĭen căi
en: venerable sir, you are very hale and hearty.

puj: lṳ́ mih huang?1 lṳ́ sĩm-mih huang tshue lai?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ mih huang? lṳ́ sĭm-mih huang chue lâi?

puj: lṳ́ mn̄g i ôiⁿ a m̄-ôiⁿ
en: ask him whether he is at leisure.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ bô kūaⁿ bô kūaⁿ nē
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ bô̤ kūaⁿ bô̤ kūaⁿ nē
en: do not be lazy about it.
do not you bruit it about.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ chip ka-kī kâi ì
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ cip ka-kī kâi ì
en: do not be tenacious of your own notions.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ chip lṳ́ kâi ì
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ cip lṳ́ kâi ì
en: do not obstinately maintain your own opinion.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ gūa-gūa ne,7 chhin-chhiẽⁿ gūa nâng hièⁿ-seⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ gūa-gūa nē, chin-chĭeⁿ gūa nâng hìeⁿ-seⁿ
en: do not act so unconcernedly, as if you were not of us.
do not be troubled about it.
do not acquiesce in what he wishes.
do not bring misery upon yourself.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ khṳt nâng kuang khṳ̀
en: do not let people mislead you by delusive promises.
do not scare him so as to make him retreat into his hole.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ kiaⁿ lâi kio i chièn
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ kiaⁿ lâi kio i cìen
en: do not fear to fight with them.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ kún pa̍t nang,5 kún ka-kī tsū hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ kẃn pât nâng, kẃn ka-kī cū hó̤
en: you need not look after other people, if you keep yourself in order that will be sufficient.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ kún uá kâi sṳ̄ kak nâng kún kak nâng tsū hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ kẃn úa kâi sṳ̄ kak nâng kẃn kak nâng cū hó̤
en: do not you undertake to manage my affairs: if each person attends to his own business all will go well.
do not come here and idle about at times when others are engaged.
do not you come and knock over the drum-stand.
do not you come and hinder me.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ lâi tó biê thoiⁿ,2 uá tsai
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ lâi tó̤ bîe thóiⁿ, úa cai
en: you need not come and spy around, I know you are there.
do not compel him to it.
do not conceal the truth from me.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ o̍h tshùi o̍h chi̍h
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ ô̤h chùi ô̤h cîh

en: do not branch off into other subjects.
do not you fail to fulfill the appointment; do not disappoint me.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ thiàⁿ koi-chhĩ kâi iô-ngân
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ thìaⁿ koi-chĭ kâi îo-ngân
en: do not listen to floating rumours.
do not consider his being in dishabille.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ thóiⁿ tsò jî hì
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ thóiⁿ cò̤ jî hì
en: you need not look upon this as child's play.
do not distract me by your noise.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ tsang thâu-môⁿ khṳ̀ chhih húe
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ cang thâu-mô̤ⁿ khṳ̀ chih húe
en: do not go so near the fire as to singe your hair.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ tshap tshùi tshap chi̍h
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ chap chùi chap cîh
en: do not you put in your gab.
do not go and disturb it.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ tshoung-tshoung mâng-mang,5 khuaⁿ-khuaⁿ lí
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ chong-chong mâng-mâng, khuaⁿ-khuaⁿ lí
en: do not be in haste about it, arrange it at your convenience.
do not drive him too hard.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ tshut khṳ̀ pha̍k ji̍t
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ chut khṳ̀ phâk jît
en: do not go out in the sun.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ tàⁿ ke,3 si̍t-si̍t jie̍h tsōi chîⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ tàⁿ kè, sît-sît jîeh cōi cîⁿ
en: do not put on a fancy price, but tell exactly how much is to be paid for it.
do not try to appear simple.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ tó chhiè khuah nâng kâi tshùi
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ tó̤ chìe khuah nâng kâi chùi

en: you need not be palavering around me.
do not bring evil upon yourself.
do not yell as if you were receiving an official beating.
do not try to excuse yourself for it.
do not affect to be other than you are.
do not be playing tricks there.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ tõ tèⁿ sì tèⁿ ua̍h
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ tŏ̤ tèⁿ sì tèⁿ ûah
en: you need not pretend to be more dead than alive.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ ut un,1 ti̍t-ti̍t kiâⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ ut wn, tît-tît kîaⁿ
en: do not turn aside, go straight on.

puj: lṳ́ màiⁿ ùn thiⁿ ùn ti,7 tie̍h ùn lṳ́ ka-kī
puj_orig: lṳ́ màiⁿ ẁn thiⁿ ẁn tī, tîeh ẁn lṳ́ ka-kī
en: you should not complain against everybody else, you should find fault with you-self.
do not clamber over the walls.

puj: lṳ́ méⁿ-méⁿ khṳ̀ jiō i tńg-lâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ méⁿ-méⁿ khṳ̀ jīo i tńg-lâi
en: go quickly after him and bring him back.

puj: lṳ́ mín-ēng tsài-saⁿ jih,5 uá íⁿ-keng siu lió
puj_orig: lṳ́ mín-ēng cài-saⁿ jîh, úa íⁿ-keng siu lío
en: you need not urge me again and again to accept some, I have already accepted some.

puj: lṳ́ m̄ chhêng-ngũn li m̄ àiⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ chêng-ngw̆n li m̄ àiⁿ
en: if you are unwilling I do not wish it.

puj: lṳ́ m̄ chêng chhi,3 tsãi tit tsai hó a m̄-ho?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ cêng chì, căi tit cai hó̤ a m̄-hó̤?
en: Since you have not tried it, how do you know whether it is good or not?

puj: lṳ́ m̄ chêng tsò mih sṳ̄ tsò-nî õi hièⁿ hek?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ cêng cò̤ mih sṳ̄ cò̤-nî ŏ̤i hìeⁿ hêk?
en: Since you have not been doing anything, why are you so tired?

puj: lṳ́ m̄ hîm i,1 tsò tsai i hîm lṳ?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ hîm i, cò̤ cai i hîm lṳ́?
en: If you were not staring at him, how did you know he was staring at you?

puj: lṳ́ m̄ hó jĩm i thèng tsò
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ hó̤ jĭm i thèng cò̤
en: you should not trust to his careless management.
do not meddle in what does not pertain to your office.

puj: lṳ́ m̄ hó li-li la;6 lã lió seⁿ huang
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ hó̤ li-li lă; lă lío seⁿ huang
en: you must not keep stirring it, if you do it will (when eaten) produce wind (in the stomach).

puj: lṳ́ m̄ hó tiaⁿ kùe teng
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ hó̤ tiaⁿ kùe teng
en: do not put out the lamp by touching it.

puj: lṳ́ m̄ hó tsõ-tsòung kiáⁿ-tĩ chièⁿ-seⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ hó̤ cŏ̤-còng kíaⁿ-tĭ cìeⁿ-seⁿ
en: you should not thus indulge the children.

puj: lṳ́ m̄ tie̍h tsou̍k-tsou̍k-kiè khou i lâi chiah?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ tîeh côk-côk-kìe kho i lâi cîah?
en: Why do you not call the dog to come and get his food?

puj: lṳ́ m̄ tie̍h uá pàng hṳ́ piⁿ,1 chiáⁿ bõi kûe tie̍h lōu
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄ tîeh úa pàng hṳ́ piⁿ, cíaⁿ bŏi kûe tîeh lō
en: you should lean it up on that side, then it wll not encumber the road.

puj: lṳ́ m̄-hó khah khin sin tshut lâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ m̄-hó̤ khah khin sin chut lâi
en: you should not come abroad with too few extraneous supports to your dignity.
you must not let the wind blow upon you.

puj: lṳ́ pat lou,7 hó ín-tshūa i
puj_orig: lṳ́ pat lō, hó̤ ín-chūa i
en: guide him, since you know the road.

puj: lṳ́ pat thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tī-kò hún me?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ pat thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tī-kò̤ hẃn mē?
en: Have you heard of a rebellion anywhere?

puj: lṳ́ pat thòiⁿ-kìⁿ lǎu-iâ kàm chiú me?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ pat thòiⁿ-kìⁿ lǎu-îa kàm cíu mē?
en: Have you seen the gods accept the wine?

puj: lṳ́ phah-sǹg ũ tham-thâu a bô tham-thau?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ phah-sǹg ŭ tham-thâu a bô̤ tham-thâu?
en: Do you think there is anything to desire in it or not?

puj: lṳ́ phièn i tshun tshut lai,5 chē kiaⁿ tieh,5 i tsū kiu ji̍p khang tói tiàm
puj_orig: lṳ́ phìen i chun chut lâi, cē kiaⁿ tîeh, i cū kiu jîp khang tói tìam
en: if you entice him out, as soon as he is frightened he withdraws and hides himself in the depths of his hole again.
consider which one is the best.

puj: lṳ́ phīⁿ thóiⁿ hó a m̄-hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ phīⁿ thóiⁿ hó̤ a m̄-hó̤
en: you examine it by smelling it and see whether it is good.
you smell and see whether it is good.
What is your own idea about it?
What do you think of the taste of it?

puj: lṳ́ siò thóiⁿ che̍k în ũ jie̍h tsōi kâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ sìo thóiⁿ cêk în ŭ jîeh cōi kâi
en: count and see how many there are in one tier.

puj: lṳ́ siẽⁿ õi khì a boi?6
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭeⁿ ŏi khì a bŏi?
en: Do you think he is vexed about it?

puj: lṳ́ siẽⁿ ũ pōu a bo?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭeⁿ ŭ pō a bô̤?
en: Do you think that anything can be done about it?

puj: lṳ́ soiⁿ khṳ,3 aũ uá lâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ soiⁿ khṳ̀, ău úa lâi
en: you go first and afterward I will come.
yon may kill yourself by your exertions and all will be of no use.

puj: lṳ́ sî chia̍h tsú-nâng a sĩ chia̍h ka-ki?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ sî cîah cú-nâng a sĭ cîah ka-kī?
en: Does your employer board you or do you board yourself?

puj: lṳ́ sî-pie-liēn sî kim kai,5 a sĩ ngṳ̂n khṳ̀ liū kim kai?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ sî-pie-līen sî kim kâi, a sĭ ngṳ̂n khṳ̀ līu kim kâi?
en: Is your watch-chain of gold, or is it silver washed with gold?

puj: lṳ́ só tsai kâi hó o̍h uá thiaⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ só̤ cai kâi hó̤ ô̤h úa thiaⁿ
en: narrate to me what you know about it.

puj: lṳ́ sĩ bô ie-chiah-kut a m̄ si!6
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ bô̤ ie-ciah-kut a m̄ sĭ!
en: Have not you got any back-bone!

puj: lṳ́ sĩ bōi tshou pòu a sĩ bōi iùⁿ pou?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ bōi cho pò a sĭ bōi ìuⁿ pò?
en: Do you sell coarse or fine cloth?

puj: lṳ́ sĩ chia̍h pâi-to,1 a sĩ chia̍h keng-chiⁿ?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ cîah pâi-to̤, a sĭ cîah keng-cìⁿ?
en: Do you get your living as a swordsman or as a bowman?

puj: lṳ́ sĩ kio i sie pat a m̄ si?6
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ kio i sie pat a m̄ sĭ?
en: He is an acquaintance of yours, is he not?
you are a person of culture.

puj: lṳ́ sĩ m̄ tsai uāⁿ khui,3 heⁿ?7 íⁿ-keng uāⁿ khùi nõ saⁿ ji̍t lóu
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ m̄ cai ūaⁿ khùi, hēⁿ? íⁿ-keng ūaⁿ khùi nŏ̤ saⁿ jît ló
en: you did not know that the change of court dresses had taken place did you? It took place two or three days ago.

puj: lṳ́ sĩ póu tī-tiâng kâi khueh?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ pó tī-tîang kâi khueh?

puj: lṳ́ sĩ pōu kiâⁿ lai,5 a sĩ tsõ kiê kiaⁿ?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ pō kîaⁿ lâi, a sĭ cŏ̤ kîe kîaⁿ?
en: Did you come on foot, or in a chair?
Did you hear it, or see it?

puj: lṳ́ sĩ àiⁿ chhia a àiⁿ hin?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ àiⁿ chia a àiⁿ hīn?
en: Do you wish to trade on credit or for cash?

puj: lṳ́ sĩ àiⁿ iû a sĩ àiⁿ tshak?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ àiⁿ îu a sĭ àiⁿ chak?
en: Will you have it painted or have it varnished?

puj: lṳ́ sĩ àiⁿ khṳ̀ niõⁿ-hóuⁿ tshùi tèng khṳt ne̍k
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ àiⁿ khṳ̀ nĭoⁿ-hóⁿ chùi tèng khṳt nêk
en: you are going to a tiger's mouth to beg for meat.

puj: lṳ́ sĩ àiⁿ nn̂g a sĩ àiⁿ niap?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ àiⁿ n̂ng a sĭ àiⁿ nîap?
en: Shall I overhand it or run it?

puj: lṳ́ sĩ àiⁿ tiám húe-nā a sĩ tiám teng-nang?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ sĭ àiⁿ tíam húe-nā a sĭ tíam teng-nâng?
en: Are you going to light the splint torch or the lantern?

puj: lṳ́ sǹg kiám che,7 uá tsò chē kio lṳ́ bói
puj_orig: lṳ́ sǹg kíam cē, úa cò̤ cē kio lṳ́ bói
en: let me have it a little cheaper, then I will buy it from you at once.

puj: lṳ́ taⁿ hó khṳt uá khṳ,3 ē ji̍t uá tsū lâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ taⁿ hó̤ khṳt úa khṳ̀, ē jît úa cū lâi
en: let me go now and I will come another day.

puj: lṳ́ thiaⁿ i kâi uē-mn̂g tsò-nî taⁿ?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ thiaⁿ i kâi ūe-mn̂g cò̤-nî tàⁿ?
en: What do you think is the meaning of what he says?

puj: lṳ́ thiaⁿ uá taⁿ,3 lṳ́ màiⁿ lí-kún khàu
puj_orig: lṳ́ thiaⁿ úa tàⁿ, lṳ́ màiⁿ lí-kẃn khàu
en: listen to what I am saying to you and do not give yourself wholly up to crying.

puj: lṳ́ thiaⁿ uá taⁿ,3 màiⁿ tsò lṳ́ lí-kún jiáng
puj_orig: lṳ́ thiaⁿ úa tàⁿ, màiⁿ cò̤ lṳ́ lí-kẃn jíang
en: listen to what I am saying and do not give yourself up to screaming.
listen to what I have to say.
you do it in his stead.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ chiá jī sĩ lîm sĩm-mi̍h thiap kai?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ cía jī sĭ lîm sĭm-mîh thiap kâi?
en: What copy do you think has been followed in these letters?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ chiá pēⁿ ùi me?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ cía pēⁿ ùi mē?
en: Do you think his disease dangerous?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ chèng nâng kâi sim sĩ hiàng i a sĩ pũe i?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ cèng nâng kâi sim sĭ hìang i a sĭ pŭe i?
en: Do you think the hearts of the people turn toward him, or against him?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄ tsò tit sêng
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄ cò̤ tit sêng
en: see whether this can be effected.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ chí kâi a-nouⁿ-kiáⁿ ũ kṳn-ki a bo?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ cí kâi a-noⁿ-kíaⁿ ŭ kṳn-ki a bô̤?
en: Do you think this child has much vigor?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ chí kâi chèng tì khṳ̀ sêng a bue?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ cí kâi cèng tì khṳ̀ sêng a būe?
en: Do you consider that this disease has reached its climax?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ chí-kâi khió a hṳ́-kâi khio?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ cí-kâi khío a hṳ́-kâi khío?
en: Do you think this or that the prettier?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ hṳ́ lia̍p mue̍h kâi sĩ seⁿ sĩm-mueh?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ hṳ́ lîap mûeh kâi sĭ seⁿ sĭm-mûeh?
en: What do you think that little sore is that is coming out upon him?
Do you think it is good?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i iak-iak ne,7 tsò khéng su-hou̍k nâng
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i iak-iak nē, cò̤ khéng su-hôk nâng
en: you see that he is very full of life, and will not willingly be tamed down.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i koiⁿ-tshù õi tó khṳ̀ me?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i koiⁿ-chù ŏi tó̤ khṳ̀ mē?
en: Do you think his house is likely to tumble down?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi hō kùa sĩ tī ieⁿ?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ thoíⁿ i kâi hō̤ kùa sĭ tī īeⁿ?
en: What uniform do you think it is that he wears?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi iãng-tsṳ́ hó a m̄-ho?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi ĭang-cṳ́ hó̤ a m̄-hó̤?
en: Do you consider his method good or bad?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi ma̍k khàng-khang,3 i sĩ hẽng i kâi iēⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi mâk khàng-khàng, i sĭ hĕng i kâi īeⁿ
en: see how he looks at him askance, as if he hated him.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi nâng sĩ kun-tsṳ́ a sĩ sió-jin?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi nâng sĭ kun-cṳ́ a sĭ sío-jîn?
en: Do you consider him a cultivated person, or a boor?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi pī-pēⁿ sĩ tõ tī-ko?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi pī-pēⁿ sĭ tŏ̤ tī-kò̤?
en: Where do you think the trouble lies?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi sim ũ hiàng uá a bo?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi sim ŭ hìang úa a bô̤?
en: Do you think his regard is directed toward me?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi tshâi-chieh hó a m̄ ho?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ thó̤iⁿ i kâi châi-cieh hó̤ a m̄ hó̤?
en: What do you think of his qualities?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi uē ũ niũⁿ a bo?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i kâi uē ŭ nĭuⁿ a bô̤?
en: Do you think what he says extravagant?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i sĩ sĩm-mih lâi-in?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i sĭ sĭm-mih lâi-in?
en: What do you think led to it?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i sĩ sĩm-mih ì-kien?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i sĭ sĭm-mih ì-kìen?
en: What do you think his opinion to be?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i tieⁿ sĩm-mih môⁿ-iãng
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i tieⁿ sĭm-mih mô̤ⁿ-ĭang

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i õi seⁿ kou a bõi
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i ŏi seⁿ ko a bŏi
en: you see whether it has become mouldy or not.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i ũ ngũi sim a bou?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i ŭ ngŭi sim a bô?
en: Do you think he is false-hearted or not?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i ũ tsũe a bo?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ i ŭ cŭe a bô̤?
en: Do you think him guilty or not?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ khá m̄ sĩ sie tâng
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ khá m̄ sĭ sie tâng
en: you consider whether they can be otherwise than identical.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ khǹg ũ sĩm-mue̍h tõ
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ khǹg ŭ sĭm-mûeh tŏ̤
en: you look and see what there is put away there.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ kàⁿ phû a būe
en: you look and see if the yeast is light yet.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ kî chêng lo̍h a būe
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ kî cêng lô̤h a būe
en: see whether the flag is hauled down yet or not.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ sai-kouk hùe kâi nâng hó a tang-iêⁿ hùe kâi nâng ho?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ sai-kok hùe kâi nâng hó̤ a tang-îeⁿ hùe kâi nâng hó̤?
en: Which do you consider the better the people of western or of eastern lands?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ siõ a m̄ siõ
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ sĭo a m̄ sĭo
en: do you think the likeness good?
look at the clock and see what time it is.
What do you think about it?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ sĩ keh-chia̍h a sĩ hún ui?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ sĭ keh-cîah a sĭ hẃn ūi?
en: Do you think it is a contraction of the gullet which prevents the food being swallowed, or that the stomach refuses to retain the food after it is swallowed?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ta̍k a m̄ tak?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ tâk a m̄ tâk?
en: Do you think it worth that?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ thiⁿ õi kng a būe
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ thiⁿ ŏi kng a būe
en: see whether the day is yet dawning.

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ thó-tǹg a m̄ thó-tnng?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ thó̤-tǹg a m̄ thó̤-tǹng?
en: Do you consider it all securely settled or not?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ tie̍h chheng kuaⁿ-húe ho,2 a chheng sim-húe ho,2 a sĩ chheng hùi-húe ho?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ tîeh cheng kuaⁿ-húe hó̤, a cheng sim-húe hó̤, a sĭ cheng hùi-húe hó̤?
en: Do you think it is the liver, the heart, or the lungs, which requires medication?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ tie̍h hó a m̄-ho?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ tîeh hó̤ a m̄-hó̤?
en: Do you think it desirable, or not?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ tie̍h hó a m̄-ho?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ tîeh hó̤ a m̄-hó̤?
en: Do you consider it well to do so or not?
Do you think it will be well to do so?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ uē lâi jiên me?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ūe lâi jîen mē?
en: Do you think the portrait good?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ún-kâi ho,2 a in-kâi ho?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ún-kâi hó̤, a in-kâi hó̤?
en: Which do you think the better, theirs or ours?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ēng sĩm-mih huap lâi tshù-tì i?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ēng sĭm-mih huap lâi chù-tì i?
en: By what means do you think it might be regulated?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ũ huâng a bô huang?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ŭ hûang a bô̤ hûang?
en: Do you see any difficulties in the way?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ũ iáⁿ a bo?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ŭ íaⁿ a bô̤?
en: Do you consider that it is founded on fact?
Do you think there is any deliverance to be hoped for?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ũ lâi jit,5 a bô lâi jit?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ ŭ lâi jît, a bô̤ lâi jit?
en: Do you consider that there is a future for the enterprise, or not?

puj: lṳ́ thóiⁿ-kìⁿ che̍k kâi nâng a nõ kâi nang?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ thóiⁿ-kìⁿ cêk kâi nâng a nŏ̤ kâi nâng?
en: Did you see one person or two?

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h khiông thóiⁿ i kâi lí sĩ chièⁿ-seⁿ a m̄ sĩ
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh khîong thóiⁿ i kâi lí sĭ cìeⁿ-seⁿ a m̄ sĭ
en: you must make a thorough examination whether its principle is thus.

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h khṳt uá tsò tshái
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh khṳt úa cò̤ chái
en: you must make a suitable apology to me.

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h khṳ̀ sòi ngien;5 chiàⁿ tsai hṳ́ tói kâi ì-bī
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh khṳ̀ sòi ngîen; cìaⁿ cai hṳ́ tói kâi ì-bī
en: you must go and examine into it minutely, then you will know its inward meaning.

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h kio uá sún hó kai,5 kè-chiⁿ,2 uá li m̄ kiám lṳ́ kâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh kio úa sẃn hó̤ kâi, kè-cíⁿ, úa li m̄ kíam lṳ́ kâi
en: you choose a good one for me, and I shall not ask you to take a lower price for it.

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h kio ṳá bói hó kâi
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh kio ṳ́a bói hó̤ kâi
en: you must buy good ones for me.
you must give your whole mind to it.

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h niē uá lám ẽ ie
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh nīe úa lám ĕ ie
en: you must give me the grasp under the arms, in wrestling.
you must take care of your health.
you must be patient with me.

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h sũn i kâi ì
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh sŭn i kâi ì
en: you must act in accordance with his wishes.

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h tsai háng-heh i,1 i chiàⁿ m̄ káⁿ tsò pēⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh cai háng-heh i, i cìaⁿ m̄ káⁿ cò̤ pēⁿ
en: you must scold at him, then he will not dare behave badly.

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h tsai jiō ngio,1 màiⁿ khṳt i thau chia̍h mue̍h
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh cai jīo ngio, màiⁿ khṳt i thau cîah mûeh
en: you must remember to drive out the cat, and not let her eat up the things.
you must remember to enter it in account.

puj: lṳ́ tie̍h tsang hiang-pûi-tsãu sói chiàⁿ chheng-khih
puj_orig: lṳ́ tîeh cang hiang-pûi-cău sói cìaⁿ cheng-khih
en: use scented soap to wash it with then it will be clean.
you must support him by the arm.
you must get at the truth of the matter.
you must repeatedly and straightly charge him.
you are silent, and cannot tell.
you keep quiet and do not speak.

puj: lṳ́ tiām-tiām tha̍k tsṳ,1 màiⁿ phue̍h chí kai,5 phue̍h hṳ́ kai,5 ma̍k iā màiⁿ thóiⁿ chi,2 thóiⁿ hṳ,2 sim iā màiⁿ siẽⁿ chí siẽⁿ hṳ́ chièⁿ seⁿ tha̍k chiàⁿ kōi pat
puj_orig: lṳ́ tīam-tīam thâk cṳ, màiⁿ phûeh cí kâi, phûeh hṳ́ kâi, mâk īa màiⁿ thóiⁿ cí, thóiⁿ hṳ́, sim īa màiⁿ sĭeⁿ cí sĭeⁿ hṳ́ cìeⁿ seⁿ thâk cìaⁿ kōi pat
en: study persistently, and do not be talking of this and of that, nor be looking hither and thither, nor be thinking of all sorts of things: if you study thus, you will readily learn.

puj: lṳ́ tiām-tiām thiaⁿ thóiⁿ khà kúi khouk
puj_orig: lṳ́ tīam-tīam thiaⁿ thóiⁿ khà kúi khok
en: you listen intently and see how many raps there are on the watchman's board.

puj: lṳ́ tiō khí lâi uá chih
puj_orig: lṳ́ tīo khí lâi úa cih
en: you toss it up here and I will catch it.
What did you say in the beginning?

puj: lṳ́ to̍h m̄ pat tò khṳ,3 lṳ́ só to̍h sĩ bôu eng,7 hó kâi to̍h m̄ tie̍h
puj_orig: lṳ́ tô̤h m̄ pat tò̤ khṳ̀, lṳ́ só̤ tô̤h sĭ bô ēng, hó̤ kâi tô̤h m̄ tîeh
en: you do not know how to choose and that which you have chosen is useless, while there were good ones which you did not select.

puj: lṳ́ tsai i kâi lâi iû me?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ cai i kâi lâi îu mē?
en: Do you know how it came about?
you must think to water them.
What do you know about it!
you sit up and be ready to open the door.

puj: lṳ́ tsai tī-tiang-sî lo̍h úi ne?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ cai tī-tiang-sî lô̤h úi nē?
en: Do you know when the deputy is to be sent?

puj: lṳ́ tsai uá che̍k kù sĩ che̍k kù
puj_orig: lṳ́ cai úa cêk kù sĭ cêk kù
en: you know I mean what I say and that there is no recanting nor shuffling.
you are astray and so am I.
What do you conjecture it to be?

puj: lṳ́ tshoung-tshoung àiⁿ khṳ̀ tī kou?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ chong-chong àiⁿ khṳ̀ tī kò?
en: What are you going in such haste?

puj: lṳ́ tshò-lia̍k tàⁿ kâi phóu uá thiaⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ chò̤-lîak tàⁿ kâi phó úa thiaⁿ
en: you give me a general account of it.
How then have you become aware of this?

puj: lṳ́ tshôung tī-kò lai?5 lṳ́ tõ tī-kò lai?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ chông tī-kò̤ lâi? lṳ́ tŏ̤ tī-kò̤ lâi?

puj: lṳ́ tshú chí kâi ho,2 uá lí tshú hú kâi hó
puj_orig: lṳ́ chú cí kâi hó̤, úa lí chú hú kâi hó̤
en: you take that one for your use and I will take this one for mine.

puj: lṳ́ tshûn bô sim khṳ̀ lí
puj_orig: lṳ́ chŵn bô̤ sim khṳ̀ lí
en: you have no mind to do it.

puj: lṳ́ tshûn m̄ pat hó khiap
puj_orig: lṳ́ chŵn m̄ pat hó̤ khiap
en: you are wholly ignorant of what is best or what is worst.

puj: lṳ́ tsn̂g kâi m̄ pat chí kiãⁿ sṳ̄
puj_orig: lṳ́ cn̂g kâi m̄ pat cí kĭaⁿ sṳ̄
en: you know nothing about this matter.
do not rise; pray keep your seat.

puj: lṳ́ tsoh kang sĩ lũn jit,5 a lũn gueh?5
puj_orig: lṳ́ co̤h kang sĭ lŭn jît, a lŭn gûeh?
en: Are you working by the day or by the month?

puj: lṳ́ tsuaⁿ tie̍h tī-kò kâi chhiam?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ cuaⁿ tîeh tī-kò̤ kâi chiam?
en: To what place does the lot which you drew assign you?

puj: lṳ́ tsài khṳ̀ chhê tiāⁿ chē
puj_orig: lṳ́ cài khṳ̀ chê tīaⁿ cē
en: you go again and look it over with a view to making it more correct.
price it again, and more accurately.

puj: lṳ́ tsài siẽⁿ thóiⁿ hó a mó
puj_orig: lṳ́ cài sĭeⁿ thóiⁿ hó̤ a mó̤
en: you think it over again, whether it would be well to do it or not.

puj: lṳ́ tsá li m̄ taⁿ,3 taⁿ kek-kek tshouk-tshouk tsò tsãi tit tshut?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ cá li m̄ tàⁿ, taⁿ kek-kek chok-chok cò̤ căi tit chut?
en: You did not speak of it beforehand, and now when there is no time to do it in, how can it be done?
You ran hard enough to kill yourself! (said ironically to a slow person).
How is it that you are so well?
Why do you come so late?
How is it that you are so competent?

puj: lṳ́ tsò lṳ́ che̍k piⁿ li,2 uá tsò uá che̍k piⁿ lí
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤ lṳ́ cêk piⁿ lí, úa cò̤ úa cêk piⁿ lí
en: you attend to your affairs, and I will attend to mine.

puj: lṳ́ tsò lṳ́ táⁿ pàng tūa-tua,7 màiⁿ kiaⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤ lṳ́ táⁿ pàng tōa-tōa, màiⁿ kiaⁿ
en: be of good courage, don’t be afraid.

puj: lṳ́ tsò m̄ siu m̄ sip,5 chièⁿ nah-sap sieⁿ?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤ m̄ siu m̄ sîp, cìeⁿ nah-sap sìeⁿ?
en: Why are you so disorderly and uncleanly?

puj: lṳ́ tsò sṳ̄ màiⁿ kio a-nouⁿ-kiáⁿ hièⁿ-seⁿ
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤ sṳ̄ màiⁿ kio a-noⁿ-kíaⁿ hìeⁿ-seⁿ

puj: lṳ́ tsò sṳ̄ mâiⁿ tîⁿ sin
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤ sṳ̄ mâiⁿ tîⁿ sin
en: do things in such a way as not to involve yourself.
How is it that you are in this condition?
What use is there in your doing so?

puj: lṳ́ tsò-nî bô kio i sie kang?7
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤-nî bô̤ kio i sie kāng?
en: Why do you not share it with him?

puj: lṳ́ tsò-nî chièⁿ hãu-seⁿ siá jī chhiú õi chien?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤-nî cìeⁿ hău-seⁿ sía jī chíu ŏi cìen?
en: How is it that when you are so youthful your hand shakes when you write?
Why do you not mind when you are told?

puj: lṳ́ tsò-nî hûn-hûn ló-ló m̄ hàuⁿ hiah?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤-nî hŵn-hŵn ló̤-ló̤ m̄ hàuⁿ hiah?
en: Why are you so persistently melancholy?

puj: lṳ́ tsò-nî khuaⁿ-khuaⁿ ien,6 iẽn kàu taⁿ?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤-nî khuaⁿ-khuaⁿ ĭen, ĭen kàu taⁿ?
en: Why have you kept putting it off until now?

puj: lṳ́ tsò-nî khṳ̀ kàu sì ngõu keⁿ?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤-nî khṳ̀ kàu sì ngŏ keⁿ?
en: Why were you gone till near morning?

puj: lṳ́ tsò-nî m̄ kio uá tàⁿ tsai?1
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤-nî m̄ kio úa tàⁿ cai?
en: Why did you not tell me about it?

puj: lṳ́ tsò-nî m̄ kâi uá taⁿ?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤-nî m̄ kâi úa tàⁿ?
en: Why did you not tell me?

puj: lṳ́ tsò-nî tshûn-tshûn m̄ thiaⁿ ua?2
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤-nî chŵn-chŵn m̄ thiaⁿ úa?
en: Why do you wholly disregard my wishes?

puj: lṳ́ tsò-nî tsõ lió ē-hái thèⁿ pàng kha-thâu-u ko?3
puj_orig: lṳ́ cò̤-nî cŏ̤ lío ē-hái thèⁿ pàng kha-thâu-u kò̤?
en: Why do you sit with your knee propping your chin?
What did you say the first time?
